+    press('ArrowRight');
+    expect(onColumnLayoutChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it('is not the key of the grid when a control of the title has the focus', () => {
+    const onColumnLayoutChange = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders onColumnLayoutChange={onColumnLayoutChange} />);
+    const button = title('Customer').querySelector('button')!;
+    act(() => button.focus());
+    press('ArrowRight');
+    expect(onColumnLayoutChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the focus on the moved title', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    focusTitle('Customer');
+    press('ArrowRight');
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(title('Customer'));
+    expect(titles().indexOf(title('Customer'))).toBe(2);
+    press('ArrowRight');
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(title('Customer'));
+    expect(titles().indexOf(title('Customer'))).toBe(3);
+  });
+
+  it('scrolls the moved title into view, the least it takes', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    focusTitle('Customer');
+    // jsdom has no scrollIntoView.
+    const scrolled = vi.fn();
+    Element.prototype.scrollIntoView = scrolled;
+    try {
+      press('ArrowRight');
+      expect(scrolled).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' });
+      expect(scrolled.mock.contexts.at(-1)).toBe(title('Customer'));
+    } finally {
+      Reflect.deleteProperty(Element.prototype, 'scrollIntoView');
+    }
+  });
+
+  it('gives the focus back to the moved title when the move took it', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    focusTitle('Customer');
+    // An engine may drop the focus of a node that React moves: it is on the body after the move.
+    const drop = vi.spyOn(Node.prototype, 'insertBefore').mockImplementation(function (
+      this: Node,
+      node: Node,
+      child: Node | null,
+    ) {
+      drop.mockRestore();
+      const result = this.insertBefore(node, child);
+      (document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null)?.blur();
+      return result;
+    });
+    press('ArrowRight');
+    expect(titles().indexOf(title('Customer'))).toBe(2);
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(title('Customer'));
+  });
+
+  it('does not take a focus that is in another place of the page', () => {
+    // A menu that the key opened, say, has the focus by the time the commit of the move is done.
+    render(
+      <>
+        <Orders onColumnLayoutChange={() => elsewhere.focus()} />
+        <button type="button">elsewhere</button>
+      </>,
+    );
+    const elsewhere = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'elsewhere' });
+    focusTitle('Customer');
+    press('ArrowRight');
+    expect(titles().indexOf(title('Customer'))).toBe(2);
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(elsewhere);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the arrows going on from the moved title', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    focusTitle('Customer');
+    press('ArrowRight');
+    press('ArrowRight', {});
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(title('Total'));
+  });
+});

+// ---- Reordering the columns (spec phase 6 §3.6, §3.8, §4.3 C1 crop c) -------------------------------
+
+/** Six columns that have a width, wider than the 640px frame they stand in, for the drags and the keys. */
+const REORDER_COLUMNS = [
+  cropColumn('id', 104),

+  cropColumn('channel', 120),
+  cropColumn('qty', 80),
+  cropColumn('total', 180),

+
+const ReorderGrid = ({
+  label,
+  width = 900,

+  <div style={{ width, marginBottom: 16 }}>

+      aria-label={label}
+      data-testid={label}
+      data={SALES.slice(0, 8)}

+      height={300}

+      {...props}
+    />

+);
+
+const captionsOf = (root: HTMLElement) =>

+const rootOf = (canvasElement: HTMLElement, label: string) =>

+/** The cells of a column: its title and a cell of each row that is drawn. */
+const columnCells = (root: HTMLElement, caption: string) => {
+  const index = captionsOf(root).indexOf(caption);

+    .map(
+      (row) =>
+        Array.from(row.cells).filter((cell) => !cell.classList.contains('flg-data-grid-filler'))[
+          index
+        ],
+    )
+    .filter((cell): cell is HTMLTableCellElement => cell !== undefined);
+};
+
+/**
+ * Reordering with a real mouse, in each engine. A drag of the title of Channel to the middle of Status
+ * makes it the column before Status, with one change of the layout and no sort (the drop is not a click,
+ * the sort button under the pointer included), no selected text, and the focus still on the title. While
+ * a drag is held (pointer events the browser does not know, since a button cannot be left down) the
+ * drop line stands 2px left of the boundary, 3px wide, from the top of the heading to the bottom of what
+ * the frame shows, with a dot of 7px at its top; the chip is 16px right of and 16px below the pointer,
+ * in the top layer; the column is at 35% in the title and in every row; the page has the cursor. Below
+ * the heading there is no line and a drop changes nothing; over a pinned zone there is no line; Escape
+ * puts everything back.
+ */
+export const ReorderingColumns: Story = {
+  tags: ['no-visual'],
+  args: { onColumnLayoutChange: fn(), onSortChange: fn() },
+  render: (args) => (
+    <>
+      <ReorderGrid
+        label="Free"
+        onColumnLayoutChange={args.onColumnLayoutChange}
+        onSortChange={args.onSortChange}
+      />
+      <ReorderGrid
+        label="Pinned"
+        defaultColumnLayout={{ pinned: { id: 'left' } }}
+        onColumnLayoutChange={args.onColumnLayoutChange}
+      />
+    </>
+  ),
+  play: async ({ canvasElement, args }) => {
+    const real = await realUserEvent();
+    if (!real) return;
+    const root = rootOf(canvasElement, 'Free');
+    const frame = frameOf(root);
+    const table = tableOf(root);
+    const html = document.documentElement;
+    const calls = args.onColumnLayoutChange as ReturnType<typeof fn>;
+    await waitFor(() => expect(frame.clientHeight).toBeGreaterThan(100));
+    const original = ['Order', 'Customer', 'Status', 'Channel', 'Qty', 'Total'];
+    await expect(captionsOf(root)).toEqual(original);
+    await noTitleIsCut(root);
+
+    // A held drag of Qty over the boundary between Customer and Status.
+    const qty = titleCell(root, 'Qty');
+    const start = middleOf(qty);
+    const send = pointer('mouse', 41, start);
+    const status = titleCell(root, 'Status').getBoundingClientRect();
+    const toStatus = status.left + 20 - start.x;
+    send(qty, 'pointerdown', 0);
+    send(document, 'pointermove', toStatus);
+    await waitFor(() => expect(dragLine(root)).not.toBeNull());
+    await frames();
+    const line = dragLine(root)!;
+    const at = line.getBoundingClientRect();
+    const head = table.tHead!.getBoundingClientRect();
+    const shown = frame.getBoundingClientRect();
+    near(at.left, status.left - 2, 1, 'the line is 2px left of the boundary');
+    near(at.width, 3, 0.5, 'the line is 3px wide');
+    near(at.top, head.top, 1.5, 'the line starts at the top of the heading');
+    near(
+      at.bottom,
+      shown.top + frame.clientTop + frame.clientHeight,

+    const chip = dragChip(root) ?? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-drag-chip')!;
+    await expect(chip).not.toBeNull();
+    const pointerAt = { x: start.x + toStatus, y: start.y };
+    const box = chip.getBoundingClientRect();
+    near(box.left, pointerAt.x + 16, 1.5, 'the chip is 16px right of the pointer');
+    near(box.top, pointerAt.y + 16, 1.5, 'and 16px below it');
+    await expect(chip).toHaveTextContent('Qty');
+    await expect(getComputedStyle(chip).pointerEvents).toBe('none');
+    if (typeof chip.showPopover === 'function')

+    for (const cell of columnCells(root, 'Status'))
+      await expect(getComputedStyle(cell).opacity).toBe('1');
+    await expect(html).toHaveAttribute('data-flg-grid-cursor', 'grabbing');
+    await expect(getComputedStyle(table.tBodies[0]!.rows[0]!.cells[1]!).cursor).toBe('grabbing');
+
+    // Below the heading there is no line, and the chip goes on.
+    const below = pointer('mouse', 41, { x: start.x, y: head.bottom + 60 });
+    below(document, 'pointermove', toStatus);
+    await waitFor(() => expect(dragLine(root)).toBeNull());
+    await expect(document.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-drag-chip')).not.toBeNull();
+    // A release there changes nothing.
+    below(document, 'pointerup', toStatus);
+    await frames();
+    await expect(captionsOf(root)).toEqual(original);
+    await expect(calls).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    await expect(document.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-drag-chip')).toBeNull();
+    await expect(html).not.toHaveAttribute('data-flg-grid-cursor');
+    for (const cell of columnCells(root, 'Qty'))
+      await expect(getComputedStyle(cell).opacity).toBe('1');
+
+    // Escape, a real key, puts it all back.
+    send(qty, 'pointerdown', 0);
+    send(document, 'pointermove', toStatus);
+    await waitFor(() => expect(dragLine(root)).not.toBeNull());
+    await real.keyboard('{Escape}');
+    await frames();
+    await expect(dragLine(root)).toBeNull();
+    await expect(document.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-drag-chip')).toBeNull();
+    await expect(html).not.toHaveAttribute('data-flg-grid-cursor');
+    await expect(captionsOf(root)).toEqual(original);
+    send(document, 'pointerup', toStatus);
+    await frames();
+    await expect(calls).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+
+    // Over a pinned zone, the column of another zone has no line and a drop cancels.
+    const other = rootOf(canvasElement, 'Pinned');
+    const customer = titleCell(other, 'Customer');
+    const from = middleOf(customer);
+    const order = titleCell(other, 'Order').getBoundingClientRect();
+    const fly = pointer('mouse', 42, from);
+    fly(customer, 'pointerdown', 0);

+};
+
+/**
+ * The keys, in each engine: <kbd>mod+Shift+→</kbd> on a title moves its column one place, the title
+ * keeps the focus after each move (React moves the node of a keyed cell, and an engine may drop the
+ * focus of a node that is moved), it is the one that shows `:focus-visible`, the frame is not scrolled
+ * up or down, and a column that is moved out of sight is scrolled to, sideways. Both platforms.
+ */
+const reorderKeys =
+  (modifier: 'Control' | 'Meta'): NonNullable<Story['play']> =>
+  async ({ canvasElement, args }) => {
+    const real = await realUserEvent();
+    if (!real) return;
+    const root = rootOf(canvasElement, 'Keys');
+    const frame = frameOf(root);
+    await waitFor(() => expect(frame.clientHeight).toBeGreaterThan(100));
+    const customer = () => titleCell(root, 'Customer');
+    await real.tab();
+    await real.keyboard('{ArrowUp}{ArrowRight}');
+    await expect(customer()).toHaveFocus();
+    frame.scrollTop = 60;
+    const scrolledTop = frame.scrollTop;
+    await expect(scrolledTop).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+    for (const [step, order] of [
+      ['Order', 'Status', 'Customer', 'Channel', 'Qty', 'Total'],
+      ['Order', 'Status', 'Channel', 'Customer', 'Qty', 'Total'],
+      ['Order', 'Status', 'Channel', 'Qty', 'Customer', 'Total'],
+    ].entries()) {
+      await real.keyboard(`{${modifier}>}{Shift>}{ArrowRight}{/Shift}{/${modifier}}`);
+      await frames();
+      await expect(captionsOf(root), `after press ${step + 1}`).toEqual(order);
+      await expect(customer(), `the focus after press ${step + 1}`).toHaveFocus();
+      await expect(customer().matches(':focus-visible')).toBe(true);
+      await expect(frame.scrollTop).toBe(scrolledTop);
+    }
+    await expect(args.onColumnLayoutChange).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
+    // The wide columns put Customer where the frame does not show it until it is scrolled to.
+    await real.keyboard(`{${modifier}>}{Shift>}{ArrowRight}{/Shift}{/${modifier}}`);
+    await frames();
+    await expect(captionsOf(root)).toEqual([
+      'Order',
+      'Status',
+      'Channel',
+      'Qty',
+      'Total',
+      'Customer',
+    ]);
+    await expect(customer()).toHaveFocus();
+    const inside = boxIn(frame, customer());
+    await expect(inside.left).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(-1);
+    await expect(inside.right).toBeLessThanOrEqual(frame.clientWidth + 1);
+    await expect(frame.scrollTop).toBe(scrolledTop);
+    // At the edge of the zone the key does nothing (and calls nothing).
+    await real.keyboard(`{${modifier}>}{Shift>}{ArrowRight}{/Shift}{/${modifier}}`);
+    await expect(args.onColumnLayoutChange).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(4);
+    // The arrows go on from where the title is now.
+    await real.keyboard('{ArrowLeft}');
+    await expect(titleCell(root, 'Total')).toHaveFocus();
+    await noTitleIsCut(root);
+  };
+
+const KeysGrid = (props: Partial<DataGridProps<Sale>>) => (
+  <ReorderGrid label="Keys" width={640} {...props} />
+);
+
+export const ColumnKeysKeepFocus: Story = {
+  tags: ['no-visual'],
+  beforeEach: onPlatform('other'),
+  args: { onColumnLayoutChange: fn() },
+  render: (args) => <KeysGrid onColumnLayoutChange={args.onColumnLayoutChange} />,
+  play: reorderKeys('Control'),
+};
+
+export const ColumnKeysKeepFocusOnAMac: Story = {
+  tags: ['no-visual'],
+  beforeEach: onPlatform('apple'),
+  args: { onColumnLayoutChange: fn() },
+  render: (args) => <KeysGrid onColumnLayoutChange={args.onColumnLayoutChange} />,
+  play: reorderKeys('Meta'),
+};
+
+/** A grid whose parent keeps the layout, and moves a column on <kbd>F9</kbd> from anywhere on the page. */
+function MovedByTheParent() {
+  const [layout, setLayout] = useState<DataGridColumnLayout>({
+    order: ['id', 'customer', 'status', 'channel', 'qty', 'total'],
+    widths: {},
+    hidden: [],
+    pinned: {},
+  });
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
+      if (event.key !== 'F9') return;
+      setLayout((current) => ({
+        ...current,
+        order: [...current.order.slice(1, 3), current.order[0]!, ...current.order.slice(3)],
+      }));
+    };
+    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
+    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
+  }, []);
+  return <ReorderGrid label="Moved" columnLayout={layout} onColumnLayoutChange={setLayout} />;
+}
+
+/**
+ * A commit that reorders the cells of a row while a cell has the focus: the focus stays on that cell, in
+ * each engine, and the arrows go on from it in the new order. The parent moves Order past Customer and
+ * Status on <kbd>F9</kbd>, a key that is pressed with the focus inside the grid.
+ */
+export const ColumnMoveKeepsCellFocus: Story = {
+  tags: ['no-visual'],
+  render: () => <MovedByTheParent />,
+  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
+    const real = await realUserEvent();
+    if (!real) return;
+    const root = rootOf(canvasElement, 'Moved');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(frameOf(root).clientHeight).toBeGreaterThan(100));
+    // Tab lands on the first cell of the first row: Order. Along to Status, in the second row.
+    await real.tab();
+    await real.keyboard('{ArrowDown}{ArrowRight}{ArrowRight}');
+    const row = () => root.querySelectorAll<HTMLTableRowElement>('tbody > tr')[1]!;
+    const cellOf = (caption: string) => row().cells[captionsOf(root).indexOf(caption)]!;
+    await expect(cellOf('Status')).toHaveFocus();
+    await real.keyboard('{F9}');
+    await frames();
+    await expect(captionsOf(root)).toEqual([
+      'Customer',
+      'Status',
+      'Order',
+      'Channel',
+      'Qty',
+      'Total',
+    ]);
+    await expect(cellOf('Status')).toHaveFocus();
+    // The arrows go on from there, in the new order: left is Customer, right is Order.
+    await real.keyboard('{ArrowRight}');
+    await expect(cellOf('Order')).toHaveFocus();
+    await real.keyboard('{F9}');
+    await frames();
+    await expect(cellOf('Order')).toHaveFocus();
+    await expect(document.activeElement?.closest('table')).toBe(tableOf(root));
+  },
+};
+
+/** The columns of C1 crop c: Order date 120, Status 140, Channel 120, Qty 80, Total 174. */
+const DRAG_COLUMNS = [
+  cropColumn('date', 120),
+  cropColumn('status', 140),
+  cropColumn('channel', 120),
+  cropColumn('qty', 80),
+  cropColumn('total', 174),
+];
+
+/**
+ * C1, crop c: Channel dragged to between Order date and Status (the harness drags what has
+ * `data-visual-drag` by the distance it says, and shoots with the button down): the column at 35%, the
+ * chip with the grip 16px from the pointer, and the 3px drop line with its dot. The pointer ends where the
+ * crop's cursor is, 154px right of and 12px below the corner of the crop, which is 178px left of and 16px
+ * above the middle of Channel's title, measured on the approved page.
+ */
+export const ColumnDragging: Story = {
+  tags: ['viewport-1440x720'],
+  render: () => (
+    <div style={{ width: 634 }}>
+      <CropGrid label="Dragging" columns={DRAG_COLUMNS} />
+    </div>
+  ),
+  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
+    const root = canvasElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid')!;
+    const widths = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('th.flg-data-grid-head'), (cell) =>
+      Math.round(cell.offsetWidth),
+    );
+    await expect(widths).toEqual([120, 140, 120, 80, 174]);
+    await noTitleIsCut(root);
+    titleCell(root, 'Channel').setAttribute('data-visual-drag', '-178,-16');
+  },
+};

   2. Nhóm theo cột này (`GroupIcon`; E). Khi có thanh nhóm hay `grouping` và `allowGrouping`.

+## Reordering columns
+
+A column can be moved by dragging its title. `allowReordering` is the default of every column
+(`true`), and a column's own `allowReordering` wins; the column of boxes cannot be moved. A column
+that cannot be moved is not a place the others are stopped at: they go past it.

+  screen moves columns with the keys below and the column menu. The whole title starts the drag,
+  its sort button included: a press that stays under 4px is the click of the button, and one that
+  goes further is a drag, whose click is not delivered, so a drag never sorts. The handle that
+  resizes and the column of boxes do not start one. The column and its cells are dimmed to 35% while
+  it is dragged, a chip with the caption follows the pointer (in the top layer, so nothing clips it),
+  and a line of 3px with a dot at its top shows where it would go. The cursor is `grabbing` over the
+  whole page until the pointer is let go. The frame scrolls sideways when the pointer is within 40px

+  the ones in the middle, the pinned ones on the right (see Pinned columns). Over another zone, below

+  among the columns that are shown, and how many there are.

+  column move it one place within its zone, past the next column that is shown. Each press is one
+  change of the layout. The title keeps the focus and is scrolled to, sideways, if it moved out of

 /** What a press of `Alt+Shift+←` or `Alt+Shift+→` on a title changes the width of its column by, in pixels. */
 export const RESIZE_KEY_STEP = 10;
+
+/** The columns of one zone: the indexes of its first and its last column. */
+export interface Zone {
+  first: number;
+  last: number;
+}
+
+/** Where a column goes: just `before` or `after` the column `target`, which `moveColumn` takes. */
+export interface Move {
+  target: string;
+  side: 'before' | 'after';
+}
+
+/**
+ * The zone of the column at `index`: the run of columns with its pin that holds it, given the pin of
+ * each data column in order. The zones are in order (left, middle, right), so a run is a zone.
+ */
+export function zoneOf(sides: readonly (DataGridPin | undefined)[], index: number): Zone {
+  let first = index;
+  let last = index;
+  while (first > 0 && sides[first - 1] === sides[index]) first -= 1;
+  while (last < sides.length - 1 && sides[last + 1] === sides[index]) last += 1;
+  return { first, last };
+}
+
+/**
+ * The boundary of a zone that a drop at `x` is for, counted from the zone's start: `edges` are the x of
+ * the boundaries of the zone's columns, one more than there are columns (the left edge of each, then
+ * the right edge of the last), and `source` is the column that is dragged, counted the same way. It is
+ * the boundary nearest to `x`, the lower one when two are as near. The two boundaries beside the column
+ * itself are no move, and so is anywhere outside the zone: `null`, where no line is drawn and a drop
+ * does nothing (spec phase 6 §3.8).
+ */
+export function dropTarget(edges: readonly number[], source: number, x: number): number | null {
+  const start = edges[0];
+  const end = edges[edges.length - 1];
+  if (start === undefined || end === undefined || x < start || x > end) return null;
+  let nearest = 0;
+  for (let edge = 1; edge < edges.length; edge += 1) {
+    if (Math.abs(edges[edge]! - x) < Math.abs(edges[nearest]! - x)) nearest = edge;
+  }
+  return nearest === source || nearest === source + 1 ? null : nearest;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The move that a drop on the boundary `edge` of a zone makes, with `edge` counted from the zone's
+ * start: before the column that starts it, or after the last column of the zone for its end. `ids` are
+ * the data columns in order, and `zone` is counted in them.
+ */
+export function dropMove(ids: readonly string[], zone: Zone, edge: number): Move {
+  const count = zone.last - zone.first + 1;
+  return edge < count
+    ? { target: ids[zone.first + edge]!, side: 'before' }
+    : { target: ids[zone.last]!, side: 'after' };
+}
+
+/**
+ * The move of the column at `index` by one place within its zone, past the next shown column (a hidden
+ * one keeps its place: `moveColumn` only moves this one). `null` at the edge of the zone, though a
+ * column of another zone lies beyond it.
+ */
+export function stepMove(
+  ids: readonly string[],
+  zone: Zone,
+  index: number,
+  step: -1 | 1,
+): Move | null {
+  const next = index + step;
+  if (next < zone.first || next > zone.last) return null;
+  return { target: ids[next]!, side: step < 0 ? 'before' : 'after' };
+}

+
+export interface ColumnDragOptions<TRow> {
+  frameRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
+  tableRef: RefObject<HTMLTableElement | null>;
+  /** The shown columns, the column of boxes first when there is one. */
+  columns: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[];
+  /** Where each of `columns` sticks, `undefined` for one in the middle. */
+  pins: readonly (PinPlace | undefined)[];
+  /** The layout as shown. */
+  layout: DataGridColumnLayout;
+  setColumnLayout: (next: DataGridColumnLayout) => void;
+  view: DragViewStore;
+  labels: DataGridLabels;
+  /** Says a text through the grid's live region. */
+  announce: (text: string) => void;
+}
+
+export interface ColumnDrag {
+  /** The press on the title of the column `columnId`: the start of a drag, when it is one that moves. */
+  onPointerDown: (event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLElement>, columnId: string) => void;
+  /** Moves a column one place within its zone (`-1` left, `1` right), as the keys do. */
+  moveBy: (columnId: string, step: -1 | 1) => void;
+  /** The id of the column that is being dragged: the rows dim it. `null` when no drag is in flight. */
+  source: string | null;
+}
+
+/** The data columns of a grid as the drag sees them: the column of boxes is not one. */
+interface DataColumns {
+  /** How many columns of the grid come before the first data column (the column of boxes). */
+  offset: number;
+  ids: string[];
+  sides: (PinPlace['side'] | undefined)[];
+}
+
+/** A drag from its first move to its end. */

+  id: string;

+  index: number;
+  zone: Zone;
+  doc: Document;
+  frame: HTMLElement;
+  table: HTMLTableElement;
+  data: DataColumns;
+  caption: string;

+  x: number;
+  y: number;
+  /** The boundary a drop would be on, counted from the start of the zone; `null` when there is none. */
+  target: number | null;
+  autoScroll: AutoScroll;
+  onScroll: () => void;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The data columns of the shown columns, with the zone each is in. The column of boxes comes first
+ * and is no data column: it is not moved, and no drop is before it.
+ */
+function dataColumnsOf<TRow>(
+  columns: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[],
+  pins: readonly (PinPlace | undefined)[],
+): DataColumns {
+  const offset = columns.findIndex((column) => column.service === undefined);
+  const start = offset < 0 ? columns.length : offset;
+  return {
+    offset: start,
+    ids: columns.slice(start).map((column) => column.id),
+    sides: pins.slice(start).map((pin) => pin?.side),
+  };
+}
+
+/**
+ * Where the pointer is over the heading, and so which boundary of the zone of the dragged column a drop
+ * would be on: the x of the boundaries is read from the titles, which are where they are now (the frame
+ * may have scrolled), and the answer is `null` outside the band of the heading, outside the zone, and
+ * where the boundary is out of sight, under a pinned zone or beyond the frame. Returns the boundary
+ * counted from the start of the zone, and its x.
+ */
+function targetAt(session: Session, x: number, y: number): { edge: number; x: number } | null {
+  const { frame, table, data, zone, index } = session;
+  const row = table.tHead?.rows[0];
+  if (!row) return null;
+  const frameBox = frame.getBoundingClientRect();
+  // The band of the heading starts at the frame's own edge, its border included: a pointer on the border
+  // is over the frame, and the heading is right under it.
+  if (y < frameBox.top || y > row.getBoundingClientRect().bottom) return null;
+  // What the frame shows sideways; the pinned zones cover the ends of what a middle column can show.
+  let from = frameBox.left + frame.clientLeft;
+  let to = from + frame.clientWidth;
+  if (data.sides[index] === undefined) {
+    const left = row.querySelector('[data-pinned="left"][data-pin-edge]');
+    const right = row.querySelector('[data-pinned="right"][data-pin-edge]');
+    if (left) from = Math.max(from, left.getBoundingClientRect().right);
+    if (right) to = Math.min(to, right.getBoundingClientRect().left);
+  }
+  if (x < from || x > to) return null;
+  const titles = cellsOf(row).slice(data.offset + zone.first, data.offset + zone.last + 1);
+  const boxes = titles.map((title) => title.getBoundingClientRect());
+  const edges = [...boxes.map((box) => box.left), boxes[boxes.length - 1]?.right ?? 0];
+  const edge = dropTarget(edges, index - zone.first, x);
+  const at = edge === null ? undefined : edges[edge];
+  if (edge === null || at === undefined || at < from - 0.5 || at > to + 0.5) return null;
+  return { edge, x: at };
+}
+
+/**
+ * Reordering the columns (spec phase 6 §3.6, §3.8, §6.3): a drag of a title, and the keys
+ * `mod+Shift+←` and `mod+Shift+→`. One `usePointerDrag` serves the whole heading, for a mouse and a
+ * pen (a finger on a title scrolls the frame).
+ *
+ * A press starts it on the title of a column that can be moved, its sort button included: one that
+ * stays under the threshold is the click of the button, and one that goes past it is a drag, whose
+ * click is never delivered, so a drag never sorts. The handle that resizes, a popup inside a title and
+ * the column of boxes are not starts. While a drag is in flight the pointer's place goes into a small
+ * store that only the chip and the drop line read, and the rows read one change at the start (the
+ * source column is dimmed) and one at the end. The column goes where the pointer is nearest to a
+ * boundary of its own zone, the pinned zones and the middle being zones of their own; the two boundaries
+ * beside the column and anywhere outside the zone or the heading are no move, and a drop there does
+ * nothing. The layout is changed once, at the release; Escape, `pointercancel` and a lost capture only
+ * take the drag away. What the drag set on the page (the cursor mark, the scroll listener, the
+ * auto-scroll) is taken off on each of those ends and when the grid goes in the middle of one.
+ *
+ * After a move by the keys the title is scrolled into view the least it takes; it keeps the focus (React
+ * moves the node of a keyed cell, and the keyboard of the grid gives back a focus that a move dropped).
+ *
+ * Everything the handlers read comes from the latest commit, so they are the same functions for as
+ * long as the grid lives.
+ */
+export function useColumnDrag<TRow>(options: ColumnDragOptions<TRow>): ColumnDrag {
+  const latest = useRef(options);
+  useWriteOnCommit(() => {
+    latest.current = options;
+  });
+  const pressed = useRef<string | null>(null);
+  const session = useRef<Session | null>(null);
+  const [source, setSource] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  // The title that a move by the keys put in a new place, and the order that move asked for.
+  const reveal = useRef<{ id: string; order: readonly string[] } | null>(null);
+
+  /** The column of `id` when it can be moved, with its place among the data columns. */
+  const movable = useCallback((id: string) => {
+    const { columns, pins } = latest.current;
+    const data = dataColumnsOf(columns, pins);
+    const index = data.ids.indexOf(id);
+    const column = columns[data.offset + index];
+    return index >= 0 && column?.allowReordering
+      ? { column, index, data, zone: zoneOf(data.sides, index) }
+      : undefined;
+  }, []);
+
+  /** Puts the column in its place in the layout: one change, and what is said about it. */
+  const commit = useCallback((id: string, caption: string, data: DataColumns, move: Move) => {
+    const { layout, setColumnLayout, labels, announce } = latest.current;
+    const order = moveColumn(layout.order, id, move.target, move.side);
+    setColumnLayout({ ...layout, order });
+    const placed = moveColumn(data.ids, id, move.target, move.side);
+    announce(labels.announceMoved(caption, placed.indexOf(id) + 1, placed.length));
+    return order;
+  }, []);
+
+  // Where the pointer is now says where the column would go, and the chip and the line follow.
+  const apply = useCallback((current: Session, x: number, y: number) => {
+    current.x = x;
+    current.y = y;
+    const found = targetAt(current, x, y);
+    current.target = found?.edge ?? null;
+    latest.current.view.set({ caption: current.caption, x, y, edge: found?.x ?? null });
+  }, []);
+
+  // Everything a drag set, taken off: the one place that does it, for each way a drag ends.
+  const settle = useCallback((current: Session) => {
+    current.autoScroll.stop();
+    current.frame.removeEventListener('scroll', current.onScroll);
+    markDragCursor(current.doc, null);
+  }, []);
+
+  const finish = useCallback(
+    (done: boolean) => {
+      const current = session.current;
+      if (!current) return;
+      session.current = null;
+      settle(current);
+      latest.current.view.set(null);
+      setSource(null);
+      if (done && current.target !== null) {
+        commit(
+          current.id,
+          current.caption,
+          current.data,
+          dropMove(current.data.ids, current.zone, current.target),
+        );
+      }
+    },
+    [settle, commit],
+  );
+
+  const drag = usePointerDrag({
+    // A finger on a title scrolls the frame: it has no drag, and the keys and the menu move columns.
+    pointerTypes: ['mouse', 'pen'],
+    onStart: ({ x, y }) => {
+      const id = pressed.current;
+      const found = id === null ? undefined : movable(id);
+      const { frameRef, tableRef } = latest.current;
+      const frame = frameRef.current;
+      const table = tableRef.current;
+      if (id === null || !found || !frame || !table) return;
+      const doc = frame.ownerDocument;
+      const next: Session = {
+        id,
+        index: found.index,
+        zone: found.zone,
+        doc,
+        frame,
+        table,
+        data: found.data,
+        caption: found.column.caption,
+        x,
+        y,
+        target: null,
+        autoScroll: createAutoScroll(frame, { axis: 'x' }),
+        // The frame scrolls under a pointer that rests: the boundaries are somewhere else now.
+        onScroll: () => apply(next, next.x, next.y),
+      };
+      session.current = next;
+      frame.addEventListener('scroll', next.onScroll, { passive: true });
+      markDragCursor(doc, 'grabbing');
+      setSource(id);
+    },
+    onMove: ({ x, y }) => {
+      const current = session.current;
+      if (!current) return;
+      apply(current, x, y);
+      current.autoScroll.update(x, y);
+    },
+    onEnd: () => finish(true),
+    onCancel: () => finish(false),
+  });
+
+  useEffect(
+    () => () => {
+      const current = session.current;
+      session.current = null;
+      if (current) {
+        settle(current);
+        latest.current.view.set(null);
+      }
+    },
+    [settle],
+  );
+
+  const moveBy = useCallback(
+    (id: string, step: -1 | 1) => {
+      const found = movable(id);
+      if (!found) return;
+      const move = stepMove(found.data.ids, found.zone, found.index, step);
+      if (!move) return;
+      reveal.current = {
+        id,
+        order: commit(id, found.column.caption, found.data, move),
+      };
+    },
+    [movable, commit],
+  );
+
+  // After the commit of a move by the keys: a title that went out of sight is brought into it, sideways
+  // (the frame is not scrolled the other way: a title sticks). The focus needs nothing here: it stays on
+  // the title, or the keyboard of the grid gives it back (measured in the three engines, which differ
+  // in what a moved node keeps). A move that the parent did not keep is not this one's: the order must
+  // be the one asked for.
+  const { layout, columns } = options;
+  useIsoLayoutEffect(() => {
+    const pending = reveal.current;
+    reveal.current = null;
+    const row = latest.current.tableRef.current?.tHead?.rows[0];
+    if (!pending || !row || !sameOrder(layout.order, pending.order)) return;
+    const title = cellsOf(row)[columns.findIndex((column) => column.id === pending.id)];
+    if (title && typeof title.scrollIntoView === 'function') {
+      title.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' });
+    }
+  }, [layout, columns]);
+
+  // The hook's handler is the same function for as long as the grid lives, and so is what this returns
+  // but `source`: it is in the grid's context, which draws every row when it changes.
+  const { onPointerDown: startDrag } = drag;
+  const onPointerDown = useCallback(
+    (event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLElement>, columnId: string) => {
+      // The handle that resizes has a press of its own, and a popup inside the title is a place of
+      // its own: a press there is for what it holds.
+      const target = event.target instanceof Element ? event.target : null;
+      if (target?.closest('.flg-data-grid-resizer')) return;
+      const popup = target?.closest(POPUP_SELECTOR);
+      if (popup && event.currentTarget.contains(popup)) return;
+      if (!movable(columnId)) return;
+      pressed.current = columnId;
+      startDrag(event);
+    },
+    [movable, startDrag],
+  );
+  return useMemo(() => ({ onPointerDown, moveBy, source }), [onPointerDown, moveBy, source]);
+}
+
+function sameOrder(a: readonly string[], b: readonly string[]): boolean {
+  return a.length === b.length && a.every((id, index) => id === b[index]);
+}
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-drag-view.ts b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-drag-view.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..430d98f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-drag-view.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import { createExternalStore, useExternalStore } from './use-external-store';
+import type { ExternalStore } from './use-external-store';
+
+/** What a column drag in flight shows: the chip that follows the pointer and the line where it would drop. */
+export interface DragView {
+  /** The caption of the column that is dragged, which the chip says. */
+  readonly caption: string;
+  /** Where the pointer is, in the client coordinates of the viewport. */
+  readonly x: number;
+  readonly y: number;
+  /**
+   * Where the column would go: the client x of the boundary it would be dropped on, `null` where it
+   * would not move (beside itself, outside its zone, outside the heading) and no line is drawn. Each
+   * snapshot is a new object, so what reads it measures again.
+   */
+  readonly edge: number | null;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The chip and the drop line of a drag, apart from what the rows read: only the layer that draws them
+ * reads this, so a move of the pointer draws no row, no title and no toolbar (spec phase 6 §3.8).
+ * `null` while no column is dragged.
+ */
+export type DragViewStore = ExternalStore<DragView>;
+
+/** One store for one grid. */
+export const createDragView = (): DragViewStore => createExternalStore<DragView>();
+
+/** The drag in flight, `null` when there is none (and on the server). */
+export const useDragView = (store: DragViewStore): DragView | null => useExternalStore(store);
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-external-store.ts b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-external-store.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4d5f965
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-external-store.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
+
+/**
+ * A value that one writer sets and a few parts read, outside what the rows read: a part that reads it
+ * draws again for each change, and nothing that does not read it does. `null` while there is nothing
+ * to say (no drag is in flight).
+ */
+export interface ExternalStore<T> {
+  get(): T | null;
+  set(next: T | null): void;
+  subscribe(listener: () => void): () => void;
+}
+
+/** One store for one grid. */
+export function createExternalStore<T>(): ExternalStore<T> {
+  let current: T | null = null;
+  const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
+  return {
+    get: () => current,
+    set(next) {
+      current = next;
+      for (const listener of [...listeners]) listener();
+    },
+    subscribe(listener) {
+      listeners.add(listener);
+      return () => void listeners.delete(listener);
+    },
+  };
+}
+
+const NONE = () => null;
+
+/** What the store holds, `null` when it holds nothing (and on the server). */
+export function useExternalStore<T>(store: ExternalStore<T>): T | null {
+  return useSyncExternalStore(store.subscribe, store.get, NONE);
+}

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/DragLayer.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/DragLayer.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c41a4e8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/DragLayer.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,92 @@
+import { useRef } from 'react';
+import type { CSSProperties, RefObject } from 'react';
+import { GripVerticalIcon } from '../../../internal/icons';
+import { useIsoLayoutEffect } from '../../../internal/use-iso-layout-effect';
+import { useDragView } from '../hooks/use-drag-view';
+import type { DragViewStore } from '../hooks/use-drag-view';
+
+/** How far the chip is from the pointer, to the right and below it (spec phase 6 §4.3 C1 "Kéo cột"). */
+const CHIP_OFFSET = 16;
+
+/**
+ * The chip that follows the pointer while a column is dragged: the grip and the caption of the column,
+ * on glass, in the top layer (`popover="manual"`, where the browser has it) so that nothing clips it or
+ * covers it, and with no pointer of its own. One per grid, drawn at the end of its root and only while
+ * a column is dragged, so no element sits in the top layer at rest. It is for the eye alone: a screen
+ * reader hears where the column went from the announcement after the drop.
+ */
+export function DragLayer({ view }: { view: DragViewStore }) {
+  const dragged = useDragView(view);
+  const chip = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
+  const dragging = dragged !== null;
+
+  // Shown once, when the chip comes: the element goes with the drag, and with it its place in the top
+  // layer. Not every browser has popovers, and the chip is then a fixed box on the page.
+  useIsoLayoutEffect(() => {
+    const element = chip.current;
+    if (dragging && element && typeof element.showPopover === 'function') {
+      try {
+        element.showPopover();
+      } catch {
+        // Not connected or already open: it shows as a plain fixed box.
+      }
+    }
+  }, [dragging]);
+
+  if (!dragged) return null;
+  return (
+    <div
+      ref={chip}
+      popover="manual"
+      aria-hidden="true"
+      className="flg-surface flg-data-grid-drag-chip"
+      style={{ left: dragged.x + CHIP_OFFSET, top: dragged.y + CHIP_OFFSET } as CSSProperties}
+    >
+      <GripVerticalIcon width={13} height={13} />
+      {dragged.caption}
+    </div>
+  );
+}
+
+/**
+ * The line where the dragged column would be dropped, with a dot at its top (spec phase 6 §4.3 C1):
+ * 3px wide, from the top of the heading to the bottom of what the frame shows, its middle 0.5px left of
+ * the boundary. It is in `.flg-data-grid-main`, as the guide of a resize is, and not in the frame,
+ * whose content it would scroll with. It is placed from the DOM after each commit of the drag, in
+ * layout pixels (scaled back by the one the grid is drawn at), and is drawn only while there is a
+ * boundary a drop would move the column to. It takes no pointer: it is for the eye alone.
+ */
+export function DropLine({
+  view,
+  frameRef,
+  tableRef,
+}: {
+  view: DragViewStore;
+  frameRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
+  tableRef: RefObject<HTMLTableElement | null>;
+}) {
+  const dragged = useDragView(view);
+  const line = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
+  const edge = dragged?.edge ?? null;
+
+  useIsoLayoutEffect(() => {
+    const element = line.current;
+    const main = element?.parentElement;
+    const frame = frameRef.current;
+    const head = tableRef.current?.tHead;
+    if (edge === null || !element || !main || !frame || !head) return;
+    const box = main.getBoundingClientRect();
+    const scale = box.width > 0 ? main.offsetWidth / box.width : 1;
+    const area = frame.getBoundingClientRect();
+    const bottom = area.top + frame.clientTop + frame.clientHeight;
+    // The heading sticks at the top of the frame when the rows have scrolled, and stands where it is
+    // when they have not (a `striped` frame has padding above it).
+    const top = Math.max(head.getBoundingClientRect().top, area.top + frame.clientTop);
+    element.style.left = `${(edge - box.left) * scale - 2}px`;
+    element.style.top = `${(top - box.top) * scale}px`;
+    element.style.height = `${Math.max(0, (bottom - top) * scale)}px`;
+  }, [edge, dragged, frameRef, tableRef]);
+
+  if (edge === null) return null;

- `src/internal/menu-key.ts`: `MenuKeyEvent`, `isMenuKey(event)` → `boolean`. `src/internal/icons.tsx`: `MoreVerticalIcon`, `PinLeftIcon`, `PinRightIcon`, `PanelIcon`, `MoveHorizontalIcon`, `EyeOffIcon`; `ArrowDirection = 'up' | 'down' | 'left' | 'right'`.
- Nội bộ:
  - `engine/column-menu.ts`: `ColumnMenuAction` (`'sortAscending' | 'sortDescending' | 'clearSorting' | 'pinLeft' | 'pinRight' | 'unpin' | 'moveLeft' | 'moveRight' | 'autoFit' | 'hide'`), `ColumnMenuEntry { action; disabled }`, `ColumnMenuInput { allowSorting; allowPinning; allowReordering; allowResizing; allowHiding; sorted; pinned; canMoveLeft; canMoveRight; canHide }`; `columnMenuGroups(input)` → `ColumnMenuEntry[][]`; `hasMenu(column, canHide)`.
  - `engine/columns.ts`: `ResolvedColumn.allowPinning`, `.allowHiding`; cột chọn dòng `false`.
  - `hooks/use-column-menu.ts`: `ColumnMenuView { open; columnId; from; point }`, `ColumnMenuStore`, `createColumnMenuStore()`, `useColumnMenuView(store)`; `ColumnMenuOptions { tableRef; columns; hideable }`; `ColumnMenuPlace = { from: HTMLElement } | { point: Point }`; `useColumnMenu(options)` → `ColumnMenuControl { store; open(columnId, place); close(); openFromKey(columnId); onPointerDown(event); onContextMenu(event, columnId); hasItems(columnId) }`.
  - `parts/ColumnMenu.tsx`: `ColumnMenuActions { sort(columnId, direction | null); pin(columnId, side | null); move(columnId, step); fit(columnId); hide(columnId) }`, `ColumnMenu({ layout, actions, restoreFocusTo })`. `parts/ColumnMenuButton.tsx`: `ColumnMenuButton({ columnId, caption })`.
  - `GridContext` thêm `menu: { store; open; close; onPointerDown; onContextMenu; contentId; hideable }`.
  - `hooks/use-grid-keyboard.ts`: tuỳ chọn `onOpenMenu(columnId)`; kết quả thêm `activeHome()`.
- DOM: `span.flg-data-grid-head-icons > button.flg-data-grid-head-button[data-more][aria-haspopup="menu"][aria-expanded]` (`aria-controls` khi mở); `div.flg-menu.flg-data-grid-column-menu` (một cho grid, sau khung).
- CSS: lớp `flg-data-grid-head-icons`, `flg-data-grid-head-button`, `flg-data-grid-column-menu` (có trong `check-dist-css.ts`); ⋮ `ButtonText` ở forced colors.
- Tương phản: check `grid-head-icon` (ngưỡng 3; phần ⋮); nhãn dòng 2.
- Story: `ColumnMenuKeys`, `ColumnMenuKeysOnAMac`, `ColumnMenuFromTheButton` (`no-visual`), `ColumnMenu` (`viewport-1440x720`).
- Consumes: `setColumnLayout`, `pinColumn`, `setHidden` (Task 2); `fit` (Task 4); `moveBy` (Task 5); `onSortPress`, `nextSort` (Plan B); `MenuPanel`, `MenuTreeContext`, `MenuItem`, `MenuSeparator`, `useTriggerPress`, `useReleaseControls`, `createExternalStore`.
- Task sau dùng: Task 7 gộp "Hide column" vào `showColumn` và dùng `announceHidden`. Plan D thêm phễu vào `.flg-data-grid-head-icons` và phần màu nhấn của `grid-head-icon`; Plan E chèn nhóm "Group by this column" vào `columnMenuGroups`.

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.menu.test.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.menu.test.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8e78045
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.menu.test.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,808 @@
+import { act, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { useState } from 'react';
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { resetDevWarnings } from '../../internal/warn';
+import { DataGrid } from './DataGrid';
+import type { DataGridColumn, DataGridColumnLayout, DataGridProps, DataGridState } from './index';
+
+// The column menu (spec phase 6 §3.6, §3.8, §4.3 C1, §6.3 "Menu cột"): the button on a title, the ways
+// to open the one menu of the grid, its items, what each does and the callbacks it makes, and where the
+// focus goes. What needs a layout engine or the top layer to be true (the menu at the pointer, the
+// focus after it closes in each engine, the button shown on hover and on focus, no scroll) is proven in
+// the stories (`DataGridColumns.stories.tsx`).
+
+// How many times a popover was shown: a menu that is showing is not shown again by a render.
+let shown: number;
+let showing: Set<Element>;
+beforeEach(() => {
+  resetDevWarnings();
+  shown = 0;
+  showing = new Set();
+  // jsdom has no layout, so every element would count as hidden to the code that looks for the
+  // controls of a cell, and no Popover API: the menu shows and hides by these stand-ins.
+  HTMLElement.prototype.checkVisibility = () => true;
+  HTMLElement.prototype.showPopover = function showPopover(this: HTMLElement) {
+    shown += 1;
+    showing.add(this);
+  };
+  HTMLElement.prototype.hidePopover = function hidePopover(this: HTMLElement) {
+    showing.delete(this);
+  };
+  const matches = Element.prototype.matches;
+  vi.spyOn(Element.prototype, 'matches').mockImplementation(function (
+    this: Element,
+    selector: string,
+  ) {
+    return selector === ':popover-open' ? showing.has(this) : matches.call(this, selector);
+  });
+});
+afterEach(() => {
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'checkVisibility');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'showPopover');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'hidePopover');
+  vi.restoreAllMocks();
+  vi.useRealTimers();
+});
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  customer: string;
+  qty: number;
+  total: number;
+}
+
+const ORDERS: Order[] = [
+  { id: 'DH-1030', customer: 'Nguyễn Minh', qty: 4, total: 1250000 },
+  { id: 'DH-1029', customer: 'Trần Hải', qty: 1, total: 890000 },
+  { id: 'DH-1028', customer: 'Lê An', qty: 12, total: 15400000 },
+];
+
+const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+  { field: 'id', caption: 'Order', rowHeader: true, width: 104 },
+  { field: 'customer', caption: 'Customer', width: 200 },
+  { field: 'qty', caption: 'Qty', dataType: 'number', width: 80 },
+  { field: 'total', caption: 'Total', dataType: 'number', width: 120 },
+];
+const ORDER = ['id', 'customer', 'qty', 'total'];
+
+function Orders(props: Partial<DataGridProps<Order>>) {
+  return (
+    <DataGrid
+      data={ORDERS}
+      rowKey="id"
+      columns={COLUMNS}
+      caption="Orders"
+      paging={false}
+      {...props}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+/** A grid whose parent keeps the layout, as a caller that saves it does. */
+function Controlled({
+  onChange,
+  ...props
+}: Partial<DataGridProps<Order>> & { onChange: (layout: DataGridColumnLayout) => void }) {
+  const [layout, setLayout] = useState<DataGridColumnLayout>({
+    order: ORDER,
+    widths: {},
+    hidden: [],
+    pinned: {},
+  });
+  return (
+    <Orders
+      columnLayout={layout}
+      onColumnLayoutChange={(next) => {
+        onChange(next);
+        setLayout(next);
+      }}
+      {...props}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+const grid = () => screen.getByRole('grid') as HTMLTableElement;
+// The titles of the columns: the filler column's is none.
+const titles = () =>
+  Array.from(grid().tHead!.rows[0]!.cells).filter(
+    (cell) => !cell.classList.contains('flg-data-grid-filler'),
+  );
+const captions = () => titles().map((cell) => cell.textContent);
+const title = (name: string) => titles().find((cell) => cell.textContent?.includes(name))!;
+const more = (name: string) =>
+  title(name).querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('.flg-data-grid-head-button');
+const menu = () => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-column-menu');
+const items = () => Array.from(menu()?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role="menuitem"]') ?? []);
+const labelsOf = () => items().map((item) => item.textContent);
+const item = (name: string) => items().find((candidate) => candidate.textContent === name)!;
+const region = () => document.querySelector('[aria-live="polite"]')!;
+const focusTitle = (name: string) => act(() => title(name).focus());
+const tick = () => act(() => void vi.advanceTimersByTime(0));
+
+/** A press and a click on a button, as a mouse makes them. */
+function click(button: HTMLElement) {
+  fireEvent.pointerDown(button, { pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', button: 0, buttons: 1 });
+  fireEvent.mouseDown(button);
+  fireEvent.pointerUp(button, { pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', button: 0, buttons: 0 });
+  fireEvent.click(button, { detail: 1 });
+}
+/** Opens the menu of a column by its button, and picks an item. */
+function choose(column: string, name: string) {
+  click(more(column)!);
+  act(() => item(name).click());
+}
+
+describe('the button on a title', () => {
+  it('is on the title of every data column, named after it and closed', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    for (const name of ['Order', 'Customer', 'Qty', 'Total']) {
+      const button = more(name)!;
+      expect(button).toBeInTheDocument();
+      expect(button.tagName).toBe('BUTTON');
+      expect(button.getAttribute('type')).toBe('button');
+      expect(button.getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe(`${name} column menu`);
+      expect(button.getAttribute('aria-haspopup')).toBe('menu');
+      expect(button.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false');
+      expect(button.hasAttribute('aria-controls')).toBe(false);
+    }
+  });
+
+  it('sits in the cluster after the sort button, or after the plain title of a column that does not sort', () => {
+    render(<Orders columns={[...COLUMNS.slice(0, 1), { ...COLUMNS[1]!, allowSorting: false }]} />);
+    const sorting = title('Order').querySelector('.flg-data-grid-head-content')!;
+    expect(Array.from(sorting.children, (part) => part.className)).toEqual([
+      'flg-table-sort',
+      'flg-data-grid-head-icons',
+    ]);
+    const plain = title('Customer').querySelector('.flg-data-grid-head-content')!;
+    expect(Array.from(plain.children, (part) => part.className)).toEqual([
+      'flg-data-grid-head-title',
+      'flg-data-grid-head-icons',
+    ]);
+    expect(plain.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-head-icons > .flg-data-grid-head-button')).not.toBe(
+      null,
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('is not on the title of the column of boxes', () => {
+    render(<Orders selectionMode="multiple" />);
+    expect(titles()[0]!.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-head-button')).toBeNull();
+    expect(grid().querySelectorAll('.flg-data-grid-head-button')).toHaveLength(4);
+  });
+
+  it('is not on a column whose menu would be empty, and the grid has no menu when no column has one', () => {
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        columns={COLUMNS.map((column) => ({
+          ...column,
+          allowSorting: false,
+          allowPinning: false,
+          allowReordering: false,
+          allowResizing: false,
+          allowHiding: false,
+        }))}
+      />,
+    );
+    expect(grid().querySelectorAll('.flg-data-grid-head-button')).toHaveLength(0);
+    expect(menu()).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('is on a column that can only be hidden, and not on the last one shown', () => {
+    const only = { allowSorting: false, allowPinning: false, allowReordering: false };
+    const { rerender } = render(
+      <Orders
+        allowResizing={false}
+        columns={COLUMNS.slice(0, 2).map((column) => ({ ...column, ...only }))}
+      />,
+    );
+    expect(grid().querySelectorAll('.flg-data-grid-head-button')).toHaveLength(2);
+    rerender(
+      <Orders
+        allowResizing={false}
+        columns={COLUMNS.slice(0, 1).map((column) => ({ ...column, ...only }))}
+      />,
+    );
+    expect(grid().querySelectorAll('.flg-data-grid-head-button')).toHaveLength(0);
+  });
+
+  it('takes its name from labels.columnMenu', () => {
+    render(<Orders labels={{ columnMenu: (caption) => `Options of ${caption}` }} />);
+    expect(more('Total')!.getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe('Options of Total');
+  });
+
+  it('is the one stop of Tab of the grid together with the other buttons of the heading', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    const stops = Array.from(grid().querySelectorAll('[tabindex="0"]'));
+    expect(stops).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(stops[0]!.tagName).toBe('TH');
+    for (const button of grid().querySelectorAll('.flg-data-grid-head-button')) {
+      expect(button.getAttribute('tabindex')).toBe('-1');
+    }
+  });
+
+  it('is reached by F2 on the title: the sort button, then Tab to the button, then Tab round', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    focusTitle('Customer');
+    fireEvent.keyDown(document.activeElement!, { key: 'F2' });
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(title('Customer').querySelector('.flg-table-sort'));
+    fireEvent.keyDown(document.activeElement!, { key: 'Tab' });
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(more('Customer'));
+    fireEvent.keyDown(document.activeElement!, { key: 'Tab' });
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(title('Customer').querySelector('.flg-table-sort'));
+  });
+
+  it('is not turned back into a stop of Tab by a render of the grid', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(<Orders />);
+    rerender(<Orders caption="Orders again" />);
+    expect(more('Customer')!.getAttribute('tabindex')).toBe('-1');
+    expect(grid().querySelectorAll('[tabindex="0"]')).toHaveLength(1);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('opening the menu', () => {
+  it('opens under the button on a press, with the title that the press focused', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    const button = more('Customer')!;
+    fireEvent.pointerDown(button, { pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', button: 0, buttons: 1 });
+    // The press is cancelled, so the browser focuses nothing, and the title has the focus.
+    expect(fireEvent.mouseDown(button)).toBe(false);
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(title('Customer'));
+    fireEvent.click(button, { detail: 1 });
+    expect(shown).toBe(1);
+    expect(button.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true');
+    expect(button.getAttribute('aria-controls')).toBe(menu()!.id);
+    expect(menu()!.getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe('Customer column menu');
+    expect(more('Total')!.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false');
+    expect(more('Total')!.hasAttribute('aria-controls')).toBe(false);
+    // The first item has the focus.
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(items()[0]);
+  });
+
+  it('opens from the keyboard on Enter or Space on the focused button, with no press', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    act(() => more('Customer')!.focus());
+    act(() => more('Customer')!.click());
+    expect(more('Customer')!.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true');
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(items()[0]);
+  });
+
+  it.each([
+    ['Alt+ArrowDown', { key: 'ArrowDown', altKey: true }],
+    ['Shift+F10', { key: 'F10', shiftKey: true }],
+    ['the ContextMenu key', { key: 'ContextMenu' }],
+  ])('opens on %s on the title, cancels the key, and opens once for a held key', (_name, init) => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    focusTitle('Customer');
+    expect(fireEvent.keyDown(document.activeElement!, init)).toBe(false);
+    expect(shown).toBe(1);
+    expect(more('Customer')!.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true');
+    // The menu has the focus now; a repeat of the key on the title is not a second opening.
+    act(() => title('Customer').focus());
+    expect(fireEvent.keyDown(title('Customer'), { ...init, repeat: true })).toBe(false);
+    expect(shown).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it('does not open on a key that is held with other modifiers, and does not take the key', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    focusTitle('Customer');
+    expect(
+      fireEvent.keyDown(document.activeElement!, {
+        key: 'ArrowDown',

+        shiftKey: true,
+      }),

+    expect(fireEvent.keyDown(document.activeElement!, { key: 'F10' })).toBe(true);
+    expect(shown).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('cancels the menu key of a column whose menu is empty, and opens nothing', () => {
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        columns={COLUMNS.map((column) => ({
+          ...column,
+          allowSorting: false,
+          allowPinning: false,
+          allowReordering: false,
+          allowResizing: false,
+          allowHiding: false,
+        }))}
+      />,
+    );
+    focusTitle('Customer');
+    expect(fireEvent.keyDown(document.activeElement!, { key: 'F10', shiftKey: true })).toBe(false);
+    expect(shown).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('opens on the key only from the title itself, not from a control in it', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    act(() => title('Customer').querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-table-sort')!.focus());
+    fireEvent.keyDown(document.activeElement!, { key: 'F10', shiftKey: true });
+    expect(shown).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('opens at the pointer on a right press on a title, and the browser has no menu there', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    expect(fireEvent.contextMenu(title('Customer'), { clientX: 140, clientY: 30 })).toBe(false);
+    expect(shown).toBe(1);

+  });
+
+  it('leaves the right press on the title of the column of boxes to the browser', () => {
+    render(<Orders selectionMode="multiple" />);
+    expect(fireEvent.contextMenu(titles()[0]!, { clientX: 10, clientY: 10 })).toBe(true);
+    expect(shown).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('leaves the right press to the browser on a column whose menu is empty', () => {
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        columns={COLUMNS.map((column) => ({
+          ...column,
+          allowSorting: false,
+          allowPinning: false,
+          allowReordering: false,
+          allowResizing: false,
+          allowHiding: false,
+        }))}
+      />,

+
+  it('waits for the end of a press whose contextmenu comes before the button is released', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    fireEvent.pointerDown(title('Customer'), {
+      pointerId: 2,
+      pointerType: 'mouse',
+      button: 2,
+      buttons: 2,
+    });
+    fireEvent.contextMenu(title('Customer'), { clientX: 140, clientY: 30 });
+    expect(shown).toBe(0);
+    fireEvent.pointerUp(document, { pointerId: 2, pointerType: 'mouse', button: 2, buttons: 0 });
+    expect(shown).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it('does not open for a press that was cancelled, and lets go of what it listened to', () => {
+    const remove = vi.spyOn(document, 'removeEventListener');
+    render(<Orders />);
+    fireEvent.pointerDown(title('Customer'), { pointerId: 2, pointerType: 'touch', buttons: 1 });
+    fireEvent.pointerCancel(document, { pointerId: 2, pointerType: 'touch' });
+    expect(shown).toBe(0);
+    expect(remove.mock.calls.map((call) => call[0])).toEqual(
+      expect.arrayContaining(['pointerup', 'pointercancel']),
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('is closed by a second press on the button of the open menu, and does not open again', () => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers();
+    render(<Orders />);
+    click(more('Customer')!);
+    expect(more('Customer')!.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true');
+    click(more('Customer')!);
+    expect(more('Customer')!.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false');
+    act(() => void vi.advanceTimersByTime(50));
+    expect(more('Customer')!.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false');
+    expect(shown).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it('closes the menu and opens it afresh, a task later, for the button of another column', () => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers();
+    render(<Orders />);
+    click(more('Customer')!);
+    click(more('Total')!);
+    expect(more('Customer')!.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false');
+    expect(more('Total')!.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false');
+    tick();
+    expect(more('Customer')!.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false');
+    expect(more('Total')!.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true');
+    expect(menu()!.getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe('Total column menu');
+    expect(shown).toBe(2);
+  });
+
+  it('opens nothing for a grid that is gone before the task of a reopening', () => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers();
+    const { unmount } = render(<Orders />);
+    click(more('Customer')!);
+    click(more('Total')!);
+    unmount();
+    // (A characterization: the reopening waits in a timer that the grid takes away; the count of timers
+    // cannot say so, since jsdom queues tasks of its own when the focus moves.)
+    expect(() => vi.advanceTimersByTime(1000)).not.toThrow();
+    expect(shown).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it('makes no callback by being opened and closed', () => {
+    const onColumnLayoutChange = vi.fn();
+    const onSortChange = vi.fn();
+    const onStateChange = vi.fn();
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        onColumnLayoutChange={onColumnLayoutChange}
+        onSortChange={onSortChange}
+        onStateChange={onStateChange}
+      />,
+    );
+    click(more('Customer')!);
+    click(more('Customer')!);
+    expect(onColumnLayoutChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(onSortChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(onStateChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+});
+
+describe('the menu', () => {
+  it('is one for the grid, after the frame and outside the table, with the width of the menu of the library', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    click(more('Customer')!);
+    expect(document.querySelectorAll('.flg-data-grid-column-menu')).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(grid().contains(menu())).toBe(false);
+    expect(menu()!.getAttribute('role')).toBe('menu');
+    expect(menu()!.classList.contains('flg-menu')).toBe(true);
+    expect(menu()!.closest('.flg-data-grid')).not.toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('has the items of crop d for a column that does everything, in groups split by separators', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    click(more('Customer')!);
+    expect(labelsOf()).toEqual([
+      'Sort ascending',
+      'Sort descending',
+      'Clear sorting',
+      'Pin to the left',
+      'Pin to the right',
+      'Move left',
+      'Move right',
+      'Fit width to content',
+      'Hide column',
+    ]);
+    const parts = Array.from(menu()!.children, (part) => part.getAttribute('role'));
+    expect(parts).toEqual([
+      'menuitem',
+      'menuitem',
+      'menuitem',
+      'separator',
+      'menuitem',
+      'menuitem',
+      'separator',
+      'menuitem',
+      'menuitem',
+      'menuitem',
+      'separator',
+      'menuitem',
+    ]);
+    // Every item has its icon.
+    for (const each of items())
+      expect(each.querySelector('.flg-menu-item-icon svg')).not.toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('leaves out a group, and its separator, for what the column does not allow', () => {
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        columns={[{ ...COLUMNS[1]!, allowSorting: false, allowPinning: false, allowHiding: false }]}
+      />,
+    );
+    click(more('Customer')!);
+    expect(labelsOf()).toEqual(['Move left', 'Move right', 'Fit width to content']);
+    expect(menu()!.querySelectorAll('[role="separator"]')).toHaveLength(0);
+  });
+
+  it('says its words in labels', () => {
+    render(
+      <Orders labels={{ sortAscending: 'A to Z', pinLeft: 'Stick left', hideColumn: 'Remove' }} />,
+    );
+    click(more('Customer')!);
+    expect(labelsOf()).toEqual(
+      expect.arrayContaining(['A to Z', 'Stick left', 'Remove', 'Sort descending']),
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('turns off Clear sorting for a column that is not sorted, and on for one that is', () => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers();
+    render(<Orders defaultSort={[{ field: 'customer', direction: 'asc' }]} />);
+    click(more('Qty')!);
+    expect(item('Clear sorting').getAttribute('aria-disabled')).toBe('true');
+    tickClosed();
+    click(more('Customer')!);
+    expect(item('Clear sorting').hasAttribute('aria-disabled')).toBe(false);
+  });
+
+  it('turns off the move at the edge of the zone and the side a column is pinned on, and offers Unpin', () => {
+    render(<Orders defaultColumnLayout={{ pinned: { id: 'left', customer: 'left' } }} />);
+    click(more('Order')!);
+    expect(item('Move left').getAttribute('aria-disabled')).toBe('true');
+    expect(item('Move right').hasAttribute('aria-disabled')).toBe(false);
+    expect(item('Pin to the left').getAttribute('aria-disabled')).toBe('true');
+    expect(item('Pin to the right').hasAttribute('aria-disabled')).toBe(false);
+    expect(labelsOf()).toContain('Unpin');
+  });
+
+  it('has no Unpin for a column that is not pinned, and no Hide for the last column shown', () => {
+    render(<Orders defaultColumnLayout={{ hidden: ['id', 'qty', 'total'] }} />);
+    click(more('Customer')!);
+    expect(labelsOf()).not.toContain('Unpin');
+    expect(labelsOf()).not.toContain('Hide column');
+  });
+
+  it('is told apart by column: a button of another title opens the menu of that column', () => {
+    render(<Orders defaultColumnLayout={{ pinned: { total: 'right' } }} />);
+    click(more('Total')!);

+    expect(item('Pin to the right').getAttribute('aria-disabled')).toBe('true');
+  });
+
+  it('is not reached by the keys of the grid: a key in the menu does not move the active cell', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    focusTitle('Customer');
+    click(more('Customer')!);
+    fireEvent.keyDown(items()[0]!, { key: 'ArrowRight' });
+    fireEvent.keyDown(items()[0]!, { key: 'End' });
+    expect(title('Customer').getAttribute('tabindex')).toBe('0');
+    expect(grid().querySelectorAll('[tabindex="0"]')).toHaveLength(1);
+  });
+});
+
+// The browser closes a popover on its own for a press elsewhere and Escape (jsdom does not): the
+// stand-in of that is the same as the library's own tests use, a toggle event.
+function tickClosed() {
+  const panel = menu();
+  if (!panel) return;
+  fireEvent(panel, Object.assign(new Event('toggle'), { newState: 'closed' }));
+}
+
+describe('choosing an item', () => {
+  it('Sort ascending sorts by the column alone, once, says it, and closes the menu', () => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers();
+    const onSortChange = vi.fn();
+    const onStateChange = vi.fn();
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        defaultSort={[{ field: 'total', direction: 'desc' }]}
+        onSortChange={onSortChange}
+        onStateChange={onStateChange}
+      />,
+    );
+    choose('Customer', 'Sort ascending');
+    expect(onSortChange).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith([{ field: 'customer', direction: 'asc' }]);
+    expect(onStateChange).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
+    expect(onStateChange.mock.calls[0]![1]).toBe('sort');
+    tick();
+    expect(region()).toHaveTextContent('Sorted by Customer, ascending');
+    expect(more('Customer')!.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false');
+    expect(title('Customer').getAttribute('aria-sort')).toBe('ascending');
+  });
+
+  it('Sort descending sorts by the column alone', () => {
+    const onSortChange = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders onSortChange={onSortChange} />);
+    choose('Qty', 'Sort descending');
+    expect(onSortChange).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith([{ field: 'qty', direction: 'desc' }]);
+  });
+
+  it('calls nothing for a sort that is the sort already', () => {
+    const onSortChange = vi.fn();
+    render(
+      <Orders defaultSort={[{ field: 'qty', direction: 'desc' }]} onSortChange={onSortChange} />,
+    );
+    choose('Qty', 'Sort descending');
+    expect(onSortChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it('Clear sorting takes the level of the column out and keeps the others', () => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers();
+    const onSortChange = vi.fn();
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        defaultSort={[
+          { field: 'customer', direction: 'asc' },
+          { field: 'qty', direction: 'desc' },
+        ]}
+        onSortChange={onSortChange}
+      />,
+    );
+    choose('Customer', 'Clear sorting');
+    expect(onSortChange).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith([{ field: 'qty', direction: 'desc' }]);
+    tick();
+    expect(region()).toHaveTextContent('Sorted by Qty, descending');
+  });
+
+  it('Clear sorting of the only level says that the sorting is cleared', () => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers();
+    render(<Orders defaultSort={[{ field: 'customer', direction: 'asc' }]} />);
+    choose('Customer', 'Clear sorting');
+    tick();
+    expect(region()).toHaveTextContent('Sorting cleared');
+  });
+
+  it('does nothing for an item that is off', () => {
+    const onSortChange = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders onSortChange={onSortChange} />);
+    click(more('Customer')!);
+    act(() => item('Clear sorting').click());
+    expect(onSortChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(more('Customer')!.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true');
+  });
+
+  it('Pin to the left pins the column to the left zone: one layout change, with the state and the words', () => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers();
+    const onColumnLayoutChange = vi.fn();
+    const onStateChange = vi.fn();

+    expect(onColumnLayoutChange).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith({
+      order: ['qty', 'id', 'customer', 'total'],
+      widths: { id: 104, customer: 200, qty: 80, total: 120 },

+      pinned: { qty: 'left' },

+    expect(onStateChange).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
+    expect(onStateChange.mock.calls[0]![1]).toBe('columnLayout');
+    expect((onStateChange.mock.calls[0]![0] as DataGridState).columnLayout.pinned).toEqual({
+      qty: 'left',
+    });
+    tick();
+    expect(region()).toHaveTextContent('Qty pinned to the left');
+    expect(captions()[0]).toBe('Qty');
+    expect(title('Qty').getAttribute('data-pinned')).toBe('left');
+  });
+
+  it('Pin to the right, then Unpin', () => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers();
+    const onColumnLayoutChange = vi.fn();
+    render(<Controlled onChange={onColumnLayoutChange} />);
+    choose('Customer', 'Pin to the right');
+    expect(onColumnLayoutChange.mock.calls[0]![0].pinned).toEqual({ customer: 'right' });
+    expect(onColumnLayoutChange.mock.calls[0]![0].order).toEqual([
+      'id',
+      'qty',
+      'total',
+      'customer',
+    ]);
+    tick();
+    expect(region()).toHaveTextContent('Customer pinned to the right');
+    choose('Customer', 'Unpin');
+    expect(onColumnLayoutChange).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+    expect(onColumnLayoutChange.mock.calls[1]![0].pinned).toEqual({});
+    tick();
+    expect(region()).toHaveTextContent('Customer unpinned');
+  });
+
+  it('Move left and Move right move the column one place, with the words of a move', () => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers();
+    const onColumnLayoutChange = vi.fn();
+    render(<Controlled onChange={onColumnLayoutChange} />);
+    choose('Customer', 'Move left');
+    expect(onColumnLayoutChange.mock.calls[0]![0].order).toEqual([
+      'customer',
+      'id',
+      'qty',
+      'total',
+    ]);
+    tick();
+    expect(region()).toHaveTextContent('Customer moved to column 1 of 4');
+    choose('Customer', 'Move right');
+    expect(onColumnLayoutChange).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+    expect(onColumnLayoutChange.mock.calls[1]![0].order).toEqual(ORDER);
+  });
+
+  it('Fit width to content fits the column: one layout change with a width', () => {
+    // jsdom has no layout: a text is 8px a letter, and nothing else is measured.
+    Object.defineProperty(Range.prototype, 'getBoundingClientRect', {
+      configurable: true,
+      value(this: Range) {
+        return { width: (this.startContainer.textContent ?? '').length * 8 };

+    });
+    const onColumnLayoutChange = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders onColumnLayoutChange={onColumnLayoutChange} />);

+
+  it('Hide column hides the column: one layout change, the words, and the column is gone', () => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers();
+    const onColumnLayoutChange = vi.fn();

+    choose('Customer', 'Hide column');

+  it('says the words of the labels for what it did', () => {

+      <Orders

+
+describe('where the focus goes when the menu closes', () => {
+  it('goes back to the title the menu was opened for, after an item', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    focusTitle('Customer');
+    choose('Customer', 'Sort descending');
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(title('Customer'));
+  });
+
+  it('goes back to the title after Escape, which the browser answers by closing the popover', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    focusTitle('Customer');
+    fireEvent.keyDown(document.activeElement!, { key: 'ArrowDown', altKey: true });
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(items()[0]);
+    tickClosed();
+    expect(more('Customer')!.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false');
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(title('Customer'));
+  });
+
+  it('goes to the title of the column that took the place of a column that was hidden', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    focusTitle('Customer');
+    choose('Customer', 'Hide column');
+    expect(captions()).toEqual(['Order', 'Qty', 'Total']);
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(title('Qty'));
+    expect(title('Qty').getAttribute('tabindex')).toBe('0');
+  });
+
+  it('goes to the title of the column that was pinned, in its new place', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    focusTitle('Total');
+    choose('Total', 'Pin to the left');
+    expect(captions()[0]).toBe('Total');
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(title('Total'));
+  });
+
+  it('stays on the title after a press on the button and Escape', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    click(more('Qty')!);
+    tickClosed();
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(title('Qty'));
+  });
+});
+
+describe('the lifetime of the menu', () => {
+  it('leaves no element of the menu behind when the grid goes, and nothing runs after it', () => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers();
+    const { unmount } = render(<Orders />);
+    click(more('Customer')!);
+    unmount();
+    expect(menu()).toBeNull();
+    expect(() => vi.advanceTimersByTime(1000)).not.toThrow();
+  });
+
+  it('draws no menu items before it is first opened', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);

+    expect(items()).toHaveLength(0);

+  it('is not drawn when no column can have one, and appears when a column can', () => {

+
+describe('the menu of a column', () => {
+  const reset = () => {
+    renders.cell = 0;
+    renders.headerCell = 0;
+    renders.toolbar = 0;
+    renders.body = 0;
+  };
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    // jsdom has no Popover API.
+    HTMLElement.prototype.showPopover = () => {};
+    HTMLElement.prototype.hidePopover = () => {};
+  });
+  afterEach(() => {
+    Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'showPopover');
+    Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'hidePopover');
+  });
+
+  const mount = () => {
+    render(
+      <DataGrid
+        data={ORDERS.slice(0, 5)}
+        rowKey="id"
+        columns={COLUMNS}
+        caption="Orders"
+        paging={false}
+      />,
+    );
+    return grid().querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-head-button');
+  };
+
+  it('draws no toolbar, title, row or body for the button, the right press, the keys and the close', () => {
+    const buttons = mount();
+    expect(buttons).toHaveLength(3);
+    // The title that has the keyboard is the active one already, so the key moves nothing.
+    act(() => grid().tHead!.rows[0]!.cells[1]!.focus());
+    reset();
+    // The press and the click on the button open it, and the toggle that the browser sends closes it.
+    fireEvent.pointerDown(buttons[1]!, { pointerId: 1, buttons: 1 });
+    fireEvent.pointerUp(buttons[1]!, { pointerId: 1, buttons: 0 });
+    fireEvent.click(buttons[1]!, { detail: 1 });
+    expect(buttons[1]!.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true');
+    const menu = document.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-column-menu')!;
+    fireEvent(menu, Object.assign(new Event('toggle'), { newState: 'closed' }));
+    expect(buttons[1]!.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false');
+    // A right press on a title, and the key.
+    fireEvent.contextMenu(grid().tHead!.rows[0]!.cells[2]!, { clientX: 5, clientY: 5 });
+    expect(buttons[2]!.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true');
+    fireEvent(menu, Object.assign(new Event('toggle'), { newState: 'closed' }));
+    fireEvent.keyDown(document.activeElement!, { key: 'ArrowDown', altKey: true });
+    expect(buttons[1]!.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true');
+    expect(renders).toEqual({ headerCell: 0, toolbar: 0, body: 0, cell: 0 });
+  });
+});

+ * the title of Customer opens the menu under its button with the first item focused, and nothing is

+ * one change of the layout, the menu closed, and the focus on the title, which is in the left zone now.
+ * <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>F10</kbd> opens it again and Escape gives the focus back to the title. A real

+  await real.keyboard('{ArrowUp}{ArrowRight}');
+  await expect(titleCell(root, 'Customer')).toHaveFocus();
+  const before = scrolls(root);
+
+  await real.keyboard('{Alt>}{ArrowDown}{/Alt}');
+  await waitFor(() => expect(isOpen(menu)).toBe(true));
+  await expect(itemsOf(menu)[0]).toHaveFocus();

+  await expect(itemsOf(menu).map((item) => item.textContent)).toEqual([
+    'Sort ascending',

+  near(placed.top, button.bottom + 4, 1.5, 'the menu is 4px under the button');
+  near(placed.left, button.left, 1.5, 'the menu starts at the button');

+
+  await real.keyboard('{Shift>}{F10}{/Shift}');
+  await waitFor(() => expect(isOpen(menu)).toBe(true));
+  await expect(itemsOf(menu).map((item) => item.textContent)).toContain('Unpin');
+  await real.keyboard('{Escape}');
+  await waitFor(() => expect(isOpen(menu)).toBe(false));
+  await expect(titleCell(root, 'Customer')).toHaveFocus();
+  await expect(changed).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+

+/**
