+    await waitFor(() => expect(isOpen(menu)).toBe(true));
+    await userEvent.keyboard('{ArrowDown}{ArrowDown}');
+    await expect(document.activeElement).toHaveTextContent('Pin to the left');
+    await settled(menu);
+    // The menu of the crop: 236px, 4px of padding, items of 30px, and a line between the groups.
+    const placed = menu.getBoundingClientRect();
+    near(placed.width, 236, 0.5, 'the menu is 236px wide');
+    for (const item of itemsOf(menu)) near(item.getBoundingClientRect().height, 30, 0.5, 'an item');
+    await expect(menu.querySelectorAll('[role="separator"]')).toHaveLength(3);
+    const first = itemsOf(menu)[0]!.getBoundingClientRect();
+    near(first.top - placed.top, 5, 1, 'the first item is under the padding and the border');
+    await noTitleIsCut(root);
+  },
+};
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/column-menu.test.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/column-menu.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f7fc4e4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/column-menu.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,102 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { columnMenuGroups, hasMenu } from './column-menu';
+import type { ColumnMenuInput } from './column-menu';
+
+const ALL: ColumnMenuInput = {
+  allowSorting: true,
+  allowPinning: true,
+  allowReordering: true,
+  allowResizing: true,
+  allowHiding: true,
+  sorted: false,
+  pinned: undefined,
+  canMoveLeft: true,
+  canMoveRight: true,
+  canHide: true,
+};
+const NONE: ColumnMenuInput = {
+  ...ALL,
+  allowSorting: false,
+  allowPinning: false,
+  allowReordering: false,
+  allowResizing: false,
+  allowHiding: false,
+};
+const actions = (input: ColumnMenuInput) =>
+  columnMenuGroups(input).map((group) => group.map((entry) => entry.action));
+const disabled = (input: ColumnMenuInput) =>
+  columnMenuGroups(input)
+    .flat()
+    .filter((entry) => entry.disabled)
+    .map((entry) => entry.action);
+
+describe('columnMenuGroups', () => {
+  it('lists the groups of crop d in order for a column that can do everything', () => {
+    expect(actions(ALL)).toEqual([
+      ['sortAscending', 'sortDescending', 'clearSorting'],
+      ['pinLeft', 'pinRight'],
+      ['moveLeft', 'moveRight', 'autoFit'],
+      ['hide'],
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('has no group, and so no separator, for what a column does not allow', () => {
+    expect(actions({ ...ALL, allowSorting: false })).toEqual([
+      ['pinLeft', 'pinRight'],
+      ['moveLeft', 'moveRight', 'autoFit'],
+      ['hide'],
+    ]);
+    expect(actions({ ...NONE, allowHiding: true })).toEqual([['hide']]);
+    expect(actions({ ...NONE, allowSorting: true, allowHiding: true })).toEqual([
+      ['sortAscending', 'sortDescending', 'clearSorting'],
+      ['hide'],
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('puts the moves and the fit in one group, each by its own allow', () => {
+    expect(actions({ ...NONE, allowReordering: true })).toEqual([['moveLeft', 'moveRight']]);
+    expect(actions({ ...NONE, allowResizing: true })).toEqual([['autoFit']]);
+  });
+
+  it('leaves Hide out when the column is the last one shown', () => {
+    expect(actions({ ...ALL, canHide: false }).at(-1)).toEqual([
+      'moveLeft',
+      'moveRight',
+      'autoFit',
+    ]);
+    expect(actions({ ...NONE, allowHiding: true, canHide: false })).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('turns Clear sorting off for a column that is not sorted', () => {
+    expect(disabled(ALL)).toEqual(['clearSorting']);
+    expect(disabled({ ...ALL, sorted: true })).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('offers Unpin to a pinned column and turns off the side it is pinned on', () => {
+    expect(actions({ ...ALL, pinned: 'left' })[1]).toEqual(['pinLeft', 'pinRight', 'unpin']);
+    expect(disabled({ ...ALL, sorted: true, pinned: 'left' })).toEqual(['pinLeft']);
+    expect(disabled({ ...ALL, sorted: true, pinned: 'right' })).toEqual(['pinRight']);
+  });
+
+  it('turns a move off at the edge of the zone', () => {
+    expect(disabled({ ...ALL, sorted: true, canMoveLeft: false })).toEqual(['moveLeft']);
+    expect(disabled({ ...ALL, sorted: true, canMoveRight: false })).toEqual(['moveRight']);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('hasMenu', () => {
+  it('is true when any group has an item, and false when none has', () => {
+    expect(hasMenu(ALL, true)).toBe(true);
+    expect(hasMenu(NONE, true)).toBe(false);
+    expect(hasMenu({ ...NONE, allowHiding: true }, true)).toBe(true);
+    expect(hasMenu({ ...NONE, allowHiding: true }, false)).toBe(false);
+    for (const key of [
+      'allowSorting',
+      'allowPinning',
+      'allowReordering',
+      'allowResizing',
+    ] as const) {
+      expect(hasMenu({ ...NONE, [key]: true }, false)).toBe(true);
+    }
+  });
+});

+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { isMenuKey } from './menu-key';
+
+const key = (
+  name: string,
+  held: Partial<Record<'shift' | 'ctrl' | 'alt' | 'meta', true>> = {},
+) => ({
+  key: name,
+  shiftKey: held.shift === true,
+  ctrlKey: held.ctrl === true,
+  altKey: held.alt === true,
+  metaKey: held.meta === true,
+});
+
+describe('isMenuKey', () => {
+  it('is true for the ContextMenu key', () => {
+    expect(isMenuKey(key('ContextMenu'))).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it('is true for the ContextMenu key whatever is held with it', () => {
+    expect(isMenuKey(key('ContextMenu', { shift: true, ctrl: true, alt: true, meta: true }))).toBe(
+      true,
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('is true for Shift+F10 held with nothing else', () => {
+    expect(isMenuKey(key('F10', { shift: true }))).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it.each([
+    ['F10 alone', key('F10')],
+    ['Ctrl+Shift+F10', key('F10', { shift: true, ctrl: true })],
+    ['Alt+Shift+F10', key('F10', { shift: true, alt: true })],
+    ['Meta+Shift+F10', key('F10', { shift: true, meta: true })],
+    ['Shift+F9', key('F9', { shift: true })],
+    ['Enter', key('Enter')],
+  ])('is false for %s', (_name, event) => {
+    expect(isMenuKey(event)).toBe(false);
+  });
+});

Run:

```bash
pnpm gen:theme
pnpm vitest run --project unit --project unit-react18 --maxWorkers=3 src/components/data-grid src/internal src/components/context-menu
pnpm vitest run --project scripts --maxWorkers=3 scripts/lib/contrast.test.ts
```

Expected: FAIL.
- `src/internal/menu-key.test.ts` và `engine/column-menu.test.ts` không nạp được (`Failed to resolve import "./menu-key" from "src/internal/menu-key.test.ts". Does the file exist?`, và tương tự cho `./column-menu`).
- `src/internal/icons.test.tsx`: ca của sáu icon mới và `ArrowIcon direction right` fail.
- `engine/columns.test.ts`: ba ca `allowPinning`, `allowHiding` fail (`expected [ undefined, undefined ] to deeply equal [ true, false ]`).
- `DataGrid.menu.test.tsx` (cả hai project React): fail trên assertion (`expected [ 'flg-table-sort' ] to deeply equal [ 'flg-table-sort', 'flg-data-grid-head-icons' ]`, menu `expected null not to be null`, `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'getAttribute')`); các ca vắng mặt pass.
- Test cũ đổi theo ⋮ fail trên code cũ: `DataGrid.keyboard.test.tsx` (8 nút trong header), `DataGrid.resize.test.tsx` (độ rộng "Tự vừa" tính cụm nút), `DataGrid.reorder.test.tsx` ("không popover khi không kéo" chờ popover của menu).
- `DataGrid.test-d.ts`: lỗi kiểu (`Property 'allowPinning' does not exist on type 'DataGridProps<Order>'`, `Property 'columnMenu' does not exist on type 'DataGridLabels'`).
- `scripts/lib/contrast.test.ts`: các ca `grid-head-icon` fail (check chưa có).
- `src/components/context-menu`: test cũ của ContextMenu pass (chưa đổi gì).

Story không chạy ở bước này.

Theo báo cáo của bản nháp (phát hiện 21): `menu-key.test.ts` với stub trả `false`: 3 / 9 fail (`expected false to be true`), 6 ca phủ định pass (đặc tả của phép thử cũ, mà `ContextMenu.test.tsx` vẫn phủ); `icons.test.tsx` với stub `<svg />`: `ArrowIcon direction right` `undefined is not iterable`, sáu icon `expected null to be '0 0 24 24'`; `column-menu.test.ts` 8 / 8 fail trên stub; `DataGrid.menu.test.tsx` 50 / 55 fail, 5 pass (vắng mặt). Sau code, hai test fail vì lỗi của chính test (stub `showPopover` không làm `:popover-open` đúng; "Clear sorting" khi menu của cột khác đang mở cần sự kiện toggle trước) và một vì lỗi của code (lần mở lại bị `close()` huỷ, phát hiện 14; `expected 'false' to be 'true'`). Ca unmount là đặc tả (jsdom tự xếp task khi focus, nên số bộ đếm không nói được grid đã gỡ của mình). **Test render là đặc tả** (bản đầu fail 6 / 2 / 6 / 2 vì test dời ô hoạt động trong phần được đếm; dời focus là một lần render hợp lệ và nay xảy ra trước khi đặt lại bộ đếm). `contrast.test.ts` +7 fail trước; một đột biến của `text-muted` và của nền tiêu đề hạ số. Story viết sau code, chứng minh bằng đột biến ở ba engine: `offset` 4 → 6 làm hai story `ColumnMenuKeys` fail (`the menu is 4px under the button: 65 against 63`); `restoreFocusTo={() => null}` làm chúng fail (focus rơi về thân).

+## The column menu
+
+Every data column has a menu of what can be done to it, with one menu for the whole grid, drawn after
+the table (so that the title a screen reader reads stays short). It is the menu of the library, 236px
+wide, and its items are one change each: its callbacks are called once, and what it did is said
+through the grid's live region.
+
+- **Where it opens from.** A button with three dots at the end of the title (`aria-haspopup="menu"`,
+  `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` while it is open, named by `labels.columnMenu`): the menu opens
+  under it. The button is drawn only while its title is hovered, has the focus or holds it, or while
+  its menu is open, and always on a device with no hover; it keeps its room, so a title does not move
+  when it shows, and it stays in the accessibility tree. A right press on a title opens the menu at
+  the pointer, when the press ends. <Kbd keys="alt+down" />, <Kbd keys="shift+f10" /> and the
+  ContextMenu key on a title open it under the button, once for a key that is held; the keys are
+  cancelled on the title of every data column, also where the column has no menu. The title of the
+  column of boxes, and a column that has no menu, have no button and leave the right press to the
+  browser. A second press on the button of the open menu closes it, and the button of another title
+  closes it and opens that column's.
+- **What is in it.** In groups set apart by a line; a group with nothing in it, and its line, are
+  left out, and a column with nothing at all has no button.
+  1. `allowSorting`: Sort ascending, Sort descending (each makes the column the only level of the
+     sort, in that direction), and Clear sorting (takes this column's level out and keeps the others;
+     off when the column is not sorted).
+  2. `allowPinning`: Pin to the left, Pin to the right, and Unpin when the column is pinned. The item
+     of the side the column is pinned on is off.
+  3. `allowReordering`: Move left and Move right, which are off at the edge of the zone of the column;
+     `allowResizing`: Fit width to content (see Resizing columns).
+  4. `allowHiding`, and more than one data column shown: Hide column.
+
+  `allowPinning` and `allowHiding` are the defaults of every column of the grid, `true` when left
+  out, and a column's own wins. A column that is pinned or hidden by its own fields or by the layout
+  stays so whatever they say. A column hidden from its menu is in `hidden` of the layout, and can be
+  shown by a layout that leaves it out.
+
+- **What it says.** Sorting is said as a press on a title says it (`announceSort`,
+  `announceSortCleared`); `announcePinned`, `announceUnpinned`, `announceHidden` and
+  `announceMoved` say the rest.
+- **Where the focus goes.** The menu opens on its first item, and the arrows and the first letters
+  move among the items. When it closes, by <Kbd keys="esc" />, by an item or by a press elsewhere on
+  the grid, the focus goes to the title it was opened for: the title that took the place of a column
+  that was hidden, and the pinned title in its new place. The page and the frame are not scrolled.
+

index 0000000..0b59d6c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/column-menu.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+import type { DataGridPin } from '../types';
+
+export type ColumnMenuAction =
+  | 'sortAscending'
+  | 'sortDescending'
+  | 'clearSorting'
+  | 'pinLeft'
+  | 'pinRight'
+  | 'unpin'
+  | 'moveLeft'
+  | 'moveRight'
+  | 'autoFit'
+  | 'hide';
+
+export interface ColumnMenuEntry {
+  action: ColumnMenuAction;
+  disabled: boolean;
+}
+
+/** What the items of one column's menu depend on. */
+export interface ColumnMenuInput {
+  allowSorting: boolean;
+  allowPinning: boolean;
+  allowReordering: boolean;
+  allowResizing: boolean;
+  allowHiding: boolean;
+  /** Whether the column is one of the columns that are sorted. */
+  sorted: boolean;
+  pinned: DataGridPin | undefined;
+  /** Whether a step to the left (right) stays inside the column's zone. */
+  canMoveLeft: boolean;
+  canMoveRight: boolean;
+  /** Whether more than one data column is shown: the last one cannot be hidden. */
+  canHide: boolean;
+}
+
+type Item = ColumnMenuEntry | false;
+
+/**
+ * The groups of a column's menu, in the order of C1 crop d, each as a list of the items it has: a
+ * group with no item is left out, and the menu draws a separator between the groups that are left. The
+ * groups are built from a list, so a later plan puts its own between two of them ("Group by this
+ * column" is the second).
+ */
+export function columnMenuGroups(input: ColumnMenuInput): ColumnMenuEntry[][] {
+  const { pinned } = input;
+  const groups: Item[][] = [
+    input.allowSorting && [
+      { action: 'sortAscending', disabled: false },
+      { action: 'sortDescending', disabled: false },
+      { action: 'clearSorting', disabled: !input.sorted },
+    ],
+    input.allowPinning && [
+      { action: 'pinLeft', disabled: pinned === 'left' },
+      { action: 'pinRight', disabled: pinned === 'right' },
+      pinned !== undefined && { action: 'unpin', disabled: false },
+    ],
+    [
+      input.allowReordering && { action: 'moveLeft', disabled: !input.canMoveLeft },
+      input.allowReordering && { action: 'moveRight', disabled: !input.canMoveRight },
+      input.allowResizing && { action: 'autoFit', disabled: false },
+    ],
+    [input.allowHiding && input.canHide && { action: 'hide', disabled: false }],
+  ].filter((group): group is Item[] => group !== false);
+  return groups
+    .map((group) => group.filter((item): item is ColumnMenuEntry => item !== false))
+    .filter((group) => group.length > 0);
+}
+
+/**
+ * Whether the menu of a column has an item: the button that opens it is drawn only then. Decided by
+ * the same groups, so the button and the menu cannot disagree.
+ */
+export function hasMenu(
+  column: Pick<
+    ColumnMenuInput,
+    'allowSorting' | 'allowPinning' | 'allowReordering' | 'allowResizing' | 'allowHiding'
+  >,
+  canHide: boolean,
+): boolean {
+  return (
+    columnMenuGroups({
+      ...column,
+      sorted: false,
+      pinned: undefined,
+      canMoveLeft: true,
+      canMoveRight: true,
+      canHide,
+    }).length > 0
+  );
+}

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-column-menu.ts b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-column-menu.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..cbc2f11
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-column-menu.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,191 @@
+import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
+import type {
+  MouseEvent as ReactMouseEvent,
+  PointerEvent as ReactPointerEvent,
+  RefObject,
+} from 'react';
+import { useWriteOnCommit } from '../../../internal/use-write-on-commit';
+import type { Point } from '../../menu/menu-context';
+import { hasMenu } from '../engine/column-menu';
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from '../engine/columns';
+import { cellsOf } from '../grid-dom';
+import { createExternalStore, useExternalStore } from './use-external-store';
+import type { ExternalStore } from './use-external-store';
+
+/**
+ * What the one menu of the grid is about: the column, and where it opens (under a button, or at a
+ * point). `open` is the only part that goes back and forth: a closed menu keeps its column, so its items
+ * stay while the browser hides it and the focus is given back.
+ */
+export interface ColumnMenuView {
+  readonly open: boolean;
+  readonly columnId: string;
+  /** The button the menu opens under, or `null` when it opens at `point`. */
+  readonly from: HTMLElement | null;
+  readonly point: Point | null;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The menu's state, apart from what the rows read: the buttons of the titles and the menu read it, so
+ * opening and closing it draws no row (spec phase 6 §3.8). `null` until the menu is first opened.
+ */
+export type ColumnMenuStore = ExternalStore<ColumnMenuView>;
+
+/** One store for one grid. */
+export const createColumnMenuStore = (): ColumnMenuStore => createExternalStore<ColumnMenuView>();
+
+/** The state of the menu, `null` before it was opened (and on the server). */
+export const useColumnMenuView = (store: ColumnMenuStore): ColumnMenuView | null =>
+  useExternalStore(store);
+
+export interface ColumnMenuOptions<TRow> {
+  tableRef: RefObject<HTMLTableElement | null>;
+  /** The shown columns, the column of boxes first when there is one. */
+  columns: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[];
+  /** Whether more than one data column is shown. */
+  hideable: boolean;
+}
+
+/** Where a menu opens: under a button, or at a point of the viewport. */
+export type ColumnMenuPlace = { from: HTMLElement } | { point: Point };
+
+export interface ColumnMenuControl {
+  store: ColumnMenuStore;
+  /**
+   * Opens the menu of a column. Asked while it is open, it closes and opens afresh a task later: the
+   * press that asks has already light-dismissed the menu, and the browser reports that a task later.
+   */
+  open: (columnId: string, place: ColumnMenuPlace) => void;
+  close: () => void;
+  /** The keys on a title: opens the menu under its button; nothing when the column has no button. */
+  openFromKey: (columnId: string) => void;
+  /** The press on a title, which a `contextmenu` that comes before it ends must wait for. */
+  onPointerDown: (event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => void;
+  /** The right press on a title: the menu at the pointer, where the column has one. */
+  onContextMenu: (event: ReactMouseEvent<HTMLElement>, columnId: string) => void;
+  /** Whether the menu of a column has an item: the button on its title is drawn only then. */
+  hasItems: (columnId: string) => boolean;
+}
+
+interface Press {
+  pointerId: number;
+  /** Where the menu opens once the press ends: set by the `contextmenu` that came before the end. */
+  armed: { columnId: string; point: Point } | null;
+  stop: () => void;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Opening the one menu of a grid (spec phase 6 §3.6, §6.3). A right press opens it when the press
+ * ends: the browser light-dismisses a popover shown while a pointer is down as soon as that pointer
+ * comes up, and WebKit and Firefox fire `contextmenu` before the button is released (the same rule as
+ * `ContextMenuTrigger`'s). Everything the handlers read comes from the latest commit, so they are the
+ * same functions for as long as the grid lives.
+ */
+export function useColumnMenu<TRow>(options: ColumnMenuOptions<TRow>): ColumnMenuControl {
+  const latest = useRef(options);
+  useWriteOnCommit(() => {
+    latest.current = options;
+  });
+  const store = useMemo(createColumnMenuStore, []);
+  const reopen = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);
+  const press = useRef<Press | null>(null);
+
+  const open = useCallback(
+    (columnId: string, place: ColumnMenuPlace) => {
+      clearTimeout(reopen.current);
+      const view: ColumnMenuView = {
+        open: true,
+        columnId,
+        from: 'from' in place ? place.from : null,
+        point: 'point' in place ? place.point : null,
+      };
+      const now = store.get();
+      if (now?.open) {
+        store.set({ ...now, open: false });
+        reopen.current = setTimeout(() => store.set(view), 0);
+      } else {
+        store.set(view);
+      }
+    },
+    [store],
+  );
+
+  // A close does not cancel a reopening that is waiting: the focus that moves from the menu to the
+  // button of another column ends the menu by a timer of its own, which comes after the close that
+  // the reopening began with.
+  const close = useCallback(() => {
+    const now = store.get();
+    if (now?.open) store.set({ ...now, open: false });
+  }, [store]);
+
+  const hasItems = useCallback((columnId: string) => {
+    const { columns, hideable } = latest.current;
+    const column = columns.find((candidate) => candidate.id === columnId);
+    return column !== undefined && column.service === undefined && hasMenu(column, hideable);
+  }, []);
+
+  const openFromKey = useCallback(
+    (columnId: string) => {
+      const { columns, tableRef } = latest.current;
+      const row = tableRef.current?.tHead?.rows[0];
+      const index = columns.findIndex((column) => column.id === columnId);
+      const button = row
+        ? cellsOf(row)[index]?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-head-button[data-more]')
+        : null;
+      if (button) open(columnId, { from: button });
+    },
+    [open],
+  );
+
+  const onPointerDown = useCallback(
+    (event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
+      press.current?.stop();
+      const { pointerId } = event;
+      const current: Press = { pointerId, armed: null, stop: () => {} };
+      // A cancelled press is followed by no `pointerup`, so there is no light dismiss to wait for.
+      const onEnd = (end: PointerEvent) => {
+        if (end.pointerId !== pointerId) return;
+        current.stop();
+        if (press.current === current) press.current = null;
+        if (current.armed) open(current.armed.columnId, { point: current.armed.point });
+      };
+      current.stop = () => {
+        document.removeEventListener('pointerup', onEnd, true);
+        document.removeEventListener('pointercancel', onEnd, true);
+      };
+      document.addEventListener('pointerup', onEnd, true);
+      document.addEventListener('pointercancel', onEnd, true);
+      press.current = current;
+    },
+    [open],
+  );
+
+  const onContextMenu = useCallback(
+    (event: ReactMouseEvent<HTMLElement>, columnId: string) => {
+      if (!hasItems(columnId)) return;
+      event.preventDefault();
+      const point: Point = [event.clientX, event.clientY];
+      if (press.current) {
+        press.current.armed = { columnId, point };
+        return;
+      }
+      // After the press (Chromium on Windows), or from assistive technology: open now.
+      open(columnId, { point });
+    },
+    [hasItems, open],
+  );
+
+  useEffect(
+    () => () => {
+      clearTimeout(reopen.current);
+      press.current?.stop();
+      press.current = null;
+    },
+    [],
+  );
+
+  return useMemo(
+    () => ({ store, open, close, openFromKey, onPointerDown, onContextMenu, hasItems }),
+    [store, open, close, openFromKey, onPointerDown, onContextMenu, hasItems],
+  );
+}

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/ColumnMenu.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/ColumnMenu.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..18c8d27
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/ColumnMenu.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,192 @@
+import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
+import type { MutableRefObject, ReactNode } from 'react';
+import {
+  ArrowIcon,
+  ChevronsUpDownIcon,
+  EyeOffIcon,
+  MoveHorizontalIcon,
+  PanelIcon,
+  PinLeftIcon,
+  PinRightIcon,
+} from '../../../internal/icons';
+import { MenuTreeContext } from '../../menu/menu-context';
+import type { FocusOnOpen } from '../../menu/menu-context';
+import { MenuItem, MenuSeparator } from '../../menu/Menu';
+import { MenuPanel } from '../../menu/MenuPanel';
+import { columnMenuGroups } from '../engine/column-menu';
+import type { ColumnMenuAction } from '../engine/column-menu';
+import { stepMove, zoneOf } from '../engine/layout';
+import { useGridContext } from '../grid-context';
+import { useColumnMenuView } from '../hooks/use-column-menu';
+import type { DataGridColumnLayout, DataGridPin, DataGridSortDirection } from '../types';
+
+/** What the items of the menu do. Each is one change, with its callbacks and what is said about it. */
+export interface ColumnMenuActions {
+  /** Sorts by the column alone in a direction, or (`null`) takes its level out of the sort. */
+  sort: (columnId: string, direction: DataGridSortDirection | null) => void;
+  /** Pins the column to a side, or (`null`) unpins it. */
+  pin: (columnId: string, side: DataGridPin | null) => void;
+  move: (columnId: string, step: -1 | 1) => void;
+  fit: (columnId: string) => void;
+  hide: (columnId: string) => void;
+}
+
+// The menu opens on its first item, whichever way it was asked for.
+const FIRST: MutableRefObject<FocusOnOpen> = { current: 'first' };
+
+const icon = {
+  sortAscending: <ArrowIcon direction="up" />,
+  sortDescending: <ArrowIcon direction="down" />,
+  clearSorting: <ChevronsUpDownIcon />,
+  pinLeft: <PinLeftIcon />,
+  pinRight: <PinRightIcon />,
+  unpin: <PanelIcon />,
+  moveLeft: <ArrowIcon direction="left" />,
+  moveRight: <ArrowIcon direction="right" />,
+  autoFit: <MoveHorizontalIcon />,
+  hide: <EyeOffIcon />,
+} satisfies Record<ColumnMenuAction, ReactNode>;
+
+/**
+ * The one menu of the grid's columns (spec phase 6 §3.6, §4.3 C1, §6.3), the menu of the library
+ * (`MenuPanel`) as `ContextMenu` composes it, after the frame and outside the table so that the title
+ * a screen reader reads stays short. It opens under the button of a title or at the pointer, for the
+ * column the store says, and its items are built for that column from the layout as it is now.
+ *
+ * The focus goes where the active cell's home is when it closes (`restoreFocusTo`), read after the
+ * commit of the item that was chosen: the title of the column it was opened for, or, for a column that
+ * was hidden, the title that took its place. The items stay while the menu closes, and for a column that
+ * has just gone they are the last ones drawn, so the focus does not leave with the item that had it.
+ */
+export function ColumnMenu<TRow>({
+  layout,
+  actions,
+  restoreFocusTo,
+}: {
+  /** The layout as shown. */
+  layout: DataGridColumnLayout;
+  actions: ColumnMenuActions;
+  restoreFocusTo: () => HTMLElement | null;
+}) {
+  const { columns, pins, labels, sorting, menu } = useGridContext<TRow>();
+  const view = useColumnMenuView(menu.store);
+  const tree = useMemo(() => ({ closeAll: menu.close }), [menu.close]);
+  const found = view ? columns.find((column) => column.id === view.columnId) : undefined;
+  // The column that was hidden is no column of the grid any more, but its menu is still closing.
+  const [kept, setKept] = useState(found);
+  if (found && found !== kept) setKept(found);
+  const column = found ?? kept;
+  const point = view?.point ?? null;
+
+  const groups = (() => {
+    if (!view || !column) return [];
+    const at = columns.findIndex((candidate) => candidate.id === column.id);
+    const first = columns.findIndex((candidate) => candidate.service === undefined);
+    const ids = columns.slice(first < 0 ? columns.length : first).map((candidate) => candidate.id);
+    const sides = pins.slice(first < 0 ? columns.length : first).map((place) => place?.side);
+    const index = at - first;
+    const zone = zoneOf(sides, Math.max(0, index));
+    const canStep = (step: -1 | 1) => index >= 0 && stepMove(ids, zone, index, step) !== null;
+    return columnMenuGroups({
+      allowSorting: column.allowSorting,
+      allowPinning: column.allowPinning,
+      allowReordering: column.allowReordering,
+      allowResizing: column.allowResizing,
+      allowHiding: column.allowHiding,
+      sorted: sorting.levels.has(column.id),
+      pinned: layout.pinned[column.id],
+      canMoveLeft: canStep(-1),
+      canMoveRight: canStep(1),
+      canHide: menu.hideable,
+    });
+  })();
+
+  const run = (action: ColumnMenuAction, id: string): void => {
+    switch (action) {
+      case 'sortAscending':
+        return actions.sort(id, 'asc');
+      case 'sortDescending':
+        return actions.sort(id, 'desc');
+      case 'clearSorting':
+        return actions.sort(id, null);
+      case 'pinLeft':
+        return actions.pin(id, 'left');
+      case 'pinRight':
+        return actions.pin(id, 'right');
+      case 'unpin':
+        return actions.pin(id, null);
+      case 'moveLeft':
+        return actions.move(id, -1);
+      case 'moveRight':
+        return actions.move(id, 1);
+      case 'autoFit':
+        return actions.fit(id);
+      case 'hide':
+        return actions.hide(id);
+    }
+  };
+  const words: Record<ColumnMenuAction, string> = {
+    sortAscending: labels.sortAscending,
+    sortDescending: labels.sortDescending,
+    clearSorting: labels.clearSorting,
+    pinLeft: labels.pinLeft,
+    pinRight: labels.pinRight,
+    unpin: labels.unpin,
+    moveLeft: labels.moveLeft,
+    moveRight: labels.moveRight,
+    autoFit: labels.autoFit,
+    hide: labels.hideColumn,
+  };
+
+  return (
+    <MenuTreeContext.Provider value={tree}>
+      <MenuPanel
+        className="flg-data-grid-column-menu"
+        aria-label={column ? labels.columnMenu(column.caption) : undefined}
+        open={view?.open === true}
+        report={(open) => {
+          if (!open) menu.close();
+        }}
+        contentId={menu.contentId}
+        reference={() => {
+          if (view?.from) return view.from;
+          const [x, y] = point ?? [0, 0];
+          return { getBoundingClientRect: () => DOMRect.fromRect({ x, y, width: 0, height: 0 }) };
+        }}
+        restoreFocusTo={restoreFocusTo}
+        focusOnOpen={FIRST}
+        // Under the button, or at the pointer as a context menu is.
+        side={point ? 'right' : 'bottom'}
+        align="start"
+        offset={point ? 2 : 4}
+      >
+        {column
+          ? groups.map((group, at) => (
+              <MenuGroup key={group[0]?.action} first={at === 0}>
+                {group.map((entry) => (
+                  <MenuItem
+                    key={entry.action}
+                    icon={icon[entry.action]}
+                    disabled={entry.disabled}
+                    onSelect={() => run(entry.action, column.id)}
+                  >
+                    {words[entry.action]}
+                  </MenuItem>
+                ))}
+              </MenuGroup>
+            ))
+          : null}
+      </MenuPanel>
+    </MenuTreeContext.Provider>
+  );
+}
+
+/** A group of items, set off from the one before it by a separator. */
+function MenuGroup({ first, children }: { first: boolean; children: ReactNode }) {
+  return (
+    <>
+      {first ? null : <MenuSeparator />}
+      {children}
+    </>
+  );
+}

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..befc160
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/ColumnMenuButton.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,53 @@
+import { useRef } from 'react';
+import { dataAttr } from '../../../internal/data-attr';
+import { MoreVerticalIcon } from '../../../internal/icons';
+import { useTriggerPress } from '../../../internal/use-popover-trigger';
+import { useGridContext } from '../grid-context';
+import { focusHomeOf } from '../grid-dom';
+import { useColumnMenuView } from '../hooks/use-column-menu';
+
+/**
+ * The button on a title that opens the menu of its column (spec phase 6 §4.3 G1, C1). It reads the
+ * menu's state apart from what the rows read, so opening and closing the menu draws this button and no
+ * title, row or toolbar.
+ *
+ * A press on it is a press on the title, which is where the focus goes (the arrows go on from the title
+ * after the menu): the `mousedown` is cancelled and the title focused, as the sort button does; the
+ * click opens the menu. A second press on the button of the open menu closes it and does not open it
+ * again, which the click cannot tell by the state alone: the press has light-dismissed the menu before
+ * the click arrives (`useTriggerPress`).
+ */
+export function ColumnMenuButton({ columnId, caption }: { columnId: string; caption: string }) {
+  const { labels, menu } = useGridContext();
+  const view = useColumnMenuView(menu.store);
+  const open = view?.open === true && view.columnId === columnId;
+  const buttonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
+  const press = useTriggerPress(open, (wasOpen) => {
+    if (wasOpen) menu.close();
+    else if (buttonRef.current) menu.open(columnId, { from: buttonRef.current });
+  });
+  return (
+    <button
+      ref={buttonRef}
+      type="button"
+      className="flg-data-grid-head-button"
+      // Shown only while its title is hovered or has the focus, or while its menu is open (data-grid.css).
+      data-more={dataAttr(true)}
+      aria-label={labels.columnMenu(caption)}
+      aria-haspopup="menu"
+      aria-expanded={open}
+      aria-controls={open ? menu.contentId : undefined}
+      onPointerDown={press.onPointerDown}
+      onPointerCancel={press.onPointerCancel}
+      onMouseDown={(event) => {
+        if (event.button !== 0) return;
+        event.preventDefault();
+        const title = event.currentTarget.closest('th');
+        if (title) focusHomeOf(title);
+      }}
+      onClick={press.onClick}
+    >
+      <MoreVerticalIcon />
+    </button>
+  );
+}

diff --git a/src/internal/menu-key.ts b/src/internal/menu-key.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4923d20
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/internal/menu-key.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+/** What a key event says of its key and the modifiers held with it. */
+export interface MenuKeyEvent {
+  key: string;
+  shiftKey: boolean;
+  ctrlKey: boolean;
+  altKey: boolean;
+  metaKey: boolean;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Whether a key asks for the context menu of what has the focus: the ContextMenu key, or Shift+F10 held
+ * with nothing else. Not every browser turns these keys into a `contextmenu` event, so a menu that
+ * opens from them handles the keys itself (`ContextMenu`, the column menu of the DataGrid).
+ */
+export function isMenuKey(event: MenuKeyEvent): boolean {
+  return (
+    event.key === 'ContextMenu' ||
+    (event.key === 'F10' && event.shiftKey && !event.ctrlKey && !event.altKey && !event.metaKey)
+  );
+}

Mockup C1: crop e (popover dưới nút chọn cột, Channel bỏ chọn, Order có ổ khoá).

```diff
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.chooser.test.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.chooser.test.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c8afe47
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.chooser.test.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,549 @@
+import { act, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
+import { useState } from 'react';
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { resetDevWarnings } from '../../internal/warn';
+import { DataGrid } from './DataGrid';
+import type { DataGridColumn, DataGridColumnLayout, DataGridProps, DataGridState } from './index';
+
+// The column chooser and the toolbar (spec phase 6 §3.6, §4.3 G1 and C1, §6.3 "Thanh công cụ"): the
+// button, the popover with a box for each column, what a box does and says, and what `toolbar` lays
+// out. What needs a layout engine, the top layer or the focus of a real engine to be true (the popover
+// under its button, Tab and Space, the focus after Escape) is proven in the stories
+// (`DataGridColumns.stories.tsx`).
+
+let showing: Set<Element>;
+beforeEach(() => {
+  resetDevWarnings();
+  showing = new Set();
+  // jsdom has no layout and no Popover API: a popover shows and hides by these stand-ins.
+  HTMLElement.prototype.checkVisibility = () => true;
+  HTMLElement.prototype.showPopover = function showPopover(this: HTMLElement) {
+    showing.add(this);
+  };
+  HTMLElement.prototype.hidePopover = function hidePopover(this: HTMLElement) {
+    showing.delete(this);
+  };
+  const matches = Element.prototype.matches;
+  vi.spyOn(Element.prototype, 'matches').mockImplementation(function (
+    this: Element,
+    selector: string,
+  ) {
+    return selector === ':popover-open' ? showing.has(this) : matches.call(this, selector);
+  });
+});
+afterEach(() => {
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'checkVisibility');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'showPopover');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'hidePopover');
+  vi.restoreAllMocks();
+  vi.useRealTimers();
+});
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  customer: string;
+  qty: number;
+  total: number;
+}
+
+const ORDERS: Order[] = [
+  { id: 'DH-1030', customer: 'Nguyễn Minh', qty: 4, total: 1250000 },
+  { id: 'DH-1029', customer: 'Trần Hải', qty: 1, total: 890000 },
+];
+
+const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+  { field: 'id', caption: 'Order', rowHeader: true, width: 104, allowHiding: false },
+  { field: 'customer', caption: 'Customer', width: 200 },
+  { field: 'qty', caption: 'Qty', dataType: 'number', width: 80 },
+  { field: 'total', caption: 'Total', dataType: 'number', width: 120 },
+];
+const ORDER = ['id', 'customer', 'qty', 'total'];
+
+function Orders(props: Partial<DataGridProps<Order>>) {
+  return (
+    <DataGrid
+      data={ORDERS}
+      rowKey="id"
+      columns={COLUMNS}
+      caption="Orders"
+      columnChooser
+      paging={false}
+      {...props}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+/** A grid whose parent keeps the layout, as a caller that saves it does. */
+function Controlled({
+  onChange,
+  ...props
+}: Partial<DataGridProps<Order>> & { onChange: (layout: DataGridColumnLayout) => void }) {
+  const [layout, setLayout] = useState<DataGridColumnLayout>({
+    order: ORDER,
+    widths: {},
+    hidden: [],
+    pinned: {},
+  });
+  return (
+    <Orders
+      columnLayout={layout}
+      onColumnLayoutChange={(next) => {
+        onChange(next);
+        setLayout(next);
+      }}
+      {...props}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+const grid = () => screen.getByRole('grid') as HTMLTableElement;
+const titles = () =>
+  Array.from(grid().tHead!.rows[0]!.cells).filter(
+    (cell) => !cell.classList.contains('flg-data-grid-filler'),
+  );
+const captions = () => titles().map((cell) => cell.textContent);
+const title = (name: string) => titles().find((cell) => cell.textContent?.includes(name))!;
+const toolbar = () => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-toolbar');
+const button = () => document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('.flg-data-grid-chooser-button');
+const popover = () => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-chooser');
+const boxes = () => Array.from(popover()?.querySelectorAll<HTMLInputElement>('input') ?? []);
+const box = (name: string) =>
+  boxes().find((input) => input.closest('label')?.textContent === name)!;
+const names = () => boxes().map((input) => input.closest('label')!.textContent);
+const region = () => document.querySelector('[aria-live="polite"]')!;
+const tick = () => act(() => void vi.advanceTimersByTime(0));
+// The popovers of the toolbar are in the top layer, not part of the row.
+const classesOfToolbar = () =>
+  Array.from(toolbar()!.children)
+    .filter((child) => !child.hasAttribute('popover'))
+    .map((child) => child.className);
+const toolbarPopovers = () => document.querySelectorAll('.flg-data-grid-toolbar [popover]');
+
+/** A press and a click on a button, as a mouse makes them. */
+function click(element: HTMLElement) {
+  fireEvent.pointerDown(element, { pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', button: 0, buttons: 1 });
+  fireEvent.mouseDown(element);
+  fireEvent.pointerUp(element, { pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', button: 0, buttons: 0 });
+  fireEvent.click(element, { detail: 1 });
+}
+const open = () => click(button()!);
+
+const CAPTION = 'flg-card-header flg-data-grid-caption';
+const SPACER = 'flg-data-grid-toolbar-spacer';
+const CHOOSER = 'flg-button flg-data-grid-chooser-button';
+
+describe('the button', () => {
+  it('is an icon button named "Columns" that opens a dialog', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    const trigger = button()!;
+    expect(trigger).toHaveAccessibleName('Columns');
+    expect(trigger).toHaveAttribute('data-variant', 'secondary');
+    expect(trigger).toHaveAttribute('data-size', 'md');
+    expect(trigger).toHaveAttribute('data-icon-only');
+    expect(trigger).toHaveAttribute('aria-haspopup', 'dialog');
+    expect(trigger).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
+    expect(trigger.querySelector('svg')).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('comes after the caption and a spacer that takes the room between them', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    expect(classesOfToolbar()).toEqual([CAPTION, SPACER, CHOOSER]);
+    expect(toolbar()!.children[1]).toHaveAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
+  });
+
+  it('has the words of the label', () => {
+    render(<Orders labels={{ columnChooser: 'Spalten' }} />);
+    expect(button()).toHaveAccessibleName('Spalten');
+  });
+
+  it('is not described by its tooltip: the tooltip says the name it already has', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    expect(button()).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-describedby');
+    fireEvent.pointerEnter(button()!, { pointerType: 'mouse' });
+    expect(button()).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-describedby');
+  });
+
+  it('is not there without `columnChooser`, and mounts no popover for it', () => {
+    render(<Orders columnChooser={false} />);
+    expect(button()).toBeNull();
+    expect(popover()).toBeNull();
+    expect(toolbarPopovers()).toHaveLength(0);
+  });
+
+  it('is not there when `columnChooser` is left out', () => {
+    render(<Orders columnChooser={undefined} />);
+    expect(button()).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('opens the popover, which is a dialog named by its title', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    open();
+    const content = popover()!;
+    expect(content).toHaveAttribute('role', 'dialog');
+    const heading = content.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-chooser-title')!;
+    expect(heading).toHaveTextContent('Columns');

+    expect(button()).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');

+    expect(content).toHaveAttribute('data-align', 'end');
+    expect(content.querySelector('.flg-popover-arrow')).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+});
+
+describe('the boxes', () => {

+  it('follow the zones: the left zone, the middle, then the right zone, a hidden column at its place', () => {
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        defaultColumnLayout={{

+
+  it('draw none for the column of boxes of a grid that chooses rows', () => {

+    fireEvent.click(box('Qty'));
+    expect(box('Total')).toHaveAccessibleDescription('At least one column stays shown');
+    expect(box('Qty')).not.toHaveAccessibleDescription();
+    fireEvent.click(box('Customer'));
+    expect(box('Total')).not.toHaveAccessibleDescription();
+    expect(box('Total')).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-describedby');
+  });
+
+  it('moves the description to the next last column, in the words of the label', () => {
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        labels={{ lastShownColumn: 'Mindestens eine' }}
+        defaultColumnLayout={{ hidden: ['id', 'customer', 'qty'] }}
+      />,
+    );
+    open();
+    expect(box('Total')).toHaveAccessibleDescription('Mindestens eine');
+    fireEvent.click(box('Qty'));
+    fireEvent.click(box('Total'));
+    expect(box('Qty')).toHaveAccessibleDescription('Mindestens eine');
+    expect(box('Total')).not.toHaveAccessibleDescription();
+  });
+
+  it('says only the lock for a column that is locked and the last one shown', () => {
+    render(<Orders defaultColumnLayout={{ hidden: ['customer', 'qty', 'total'] }} />);
+    open();
+    expect(box('Order')).toBeDisabled();
+    expect(box('Order')).toHaveAccessibleDescription('Always shown');
+  });
+
+  it('is not hidden by a press on its box', async () => {
+    const onColumnLayoutChange = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders defaultColumnLayout={LAST} onColumnLayoutChange={onColumnLayoutChange} />);
+    open();
+    await userEvent.click(box('Total'));
+    expect(onColumnLayoutChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(captions()).toEqual(['Total']);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('the active cell', () => {
+  it('goes to the column now at its index when its column is hidden, and the focus stays in the popover', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    act(() => title('Customer').focus());
+    expect(title('Customer')).toHaveAttribute('tabindex', '0');
+    open();
+    act(() => box('Customer').focus());
+    fireEvent.click(box('Customer'));
+    expect(captions()).toEqual(['Order', 'Qty', 'Total']);
+    expect(title('Qty')).toHaveAttribute('tabindex', '0');
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(box('Customer'));
+  });
+});
+
+describe('the toolbar', () => {
+  it('holds the caption alone for a grid with no chooser', () => {
+    render(<Orders columnChooser={false} />);
+    expect(classesOfToolbar()).toEqual([CAPTION]);
+    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Orders' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('is not drawn without a caption, a description or an item', () => {
+    render(<Orders caption={undefined} columnChooser={false} aria-label="Orders" />);
+    expect(toolbar()).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('is drawn for a chooser alone: the spacer pushes the button to the end', () => {
+    render(<Orders caption={undefined} aria-label="Orders" />);
+    expect(classesOfToolbar()).toEqual([SPACER, CHOOSER]);
+  });
+
+  it('with `toolbar={false}` drops the items and keeps the caption', () => {
+    render(<Orders toolbar={false} description="Last week" />);
+    expect(button()).toBeNull();
+    expect(popover()).toBeNull();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Orders' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(screen.getByText('Last week')).toBeInTheDocument();
+    expect(grid()).toHaveAccessibleName('Orders');
+    expect(classesOfToolbar()).toEqual([CAPTION]);
+  });
+
+  it('with `toolbar={false}` and no caption is not drawn', () => {
+    render(<Orders toolbar={false} caption={undefined} aria-label="Orders" />);
+    expect(toolbar()).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('with a function gets both items, and draws what it returns after the caption', () => {
+    const received = vi.fn();
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        toolbar={(items) => {
+          received(items);
+          return (
+            <>
+              <button type="button">Mine</button>
+              {items.spacer}
+              {items.columnChooser}
+            </>
+          );
+        }}
+      />,
+    );
+    const items = received.mock.calls[0]![0];
+    expect(Object.keys(items).sort()).toEqual(['columnChooser', 'spacer']);
+    expect(items.spacer).not.toBeNull();
+    expect(items.columnChooser).not.toBeNull();
+    expect(classesOfToolbar()).toEqual([CAPTION, '', SPACER, CHOOSER]);
+    expect(toolbar()!.children[1]).toHaveTextContent('Mine');
+  });
+
+  it('gives a function `null` for the chooser when it is off', () => {
+    const received = vi.fn();
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        columnChooser={false}
+        toolbar={(items) => {
+          received(items);
+          return <button type="button">Mine</button>;
+        }}
+      />,
+    );
+    expect(received.mock.calls[0]![0].columnChooser).toBeNull();
+    expect(button()).toBeNull();
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Mine' })).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('with a function that returns nothing is the caption alone, or no toolbar without one', () => {
+    const { unmount } = render(<Orders toolbar={() => null} />);
+    expect(button()).toBeNull();
+    expect(classesOfToolbar()).toEqual([CAPTION]);
+    unmount();
+    render(<Orders toolbar={() => null} caption={undefined} aria-label="Orders" />);
+    expect(toolbar()).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('takes a value that is neither `false` nor a function as no `toolbar`', () => {
+    // @ts-expect-error `true` is not a toolbar
+    render(<Orders toolbar={true} />);
+    expect(button()).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('with a function that leaves the chooser out mounts no popover', () => {
+    render(<Orders toolbar={() => <span>Own</span>} />);
+    expect(button()).toBeNull();
+    expect(toolbarPopovers()).toHaveLength(0);
+  });
+});

+describe('the column chooser and the toolbar', () => {
+  const reset = () => {

+    renders.headerCell = 0;
+    renders.toolbar = 0;
+    renders.body = 0;
+  };
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    // jsdom has no Popover API.
+    HTMLElement.prototype.showPopover = () => {};
+    HTMLElement.prototype.hidePopover = () => {};
+  });
+  afterEach(() => {
+    Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'showPopover');
+    Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'hidePopover');
+  });
+
+  const grid5 = (extra: Partial<Parameters<typeof DataGrid<Order>>[0]> = {}) => (
+    <DataGrid
+      data={ORDERS.slice(0, 5)}

+      caption="Orders"
+      paging={false}
+      columnChooser
+      {...extra}
+    />
+  );
+
+  it('draws no toolbar, title, row or body for opening the chooser and closing it', () => {
+    render(grid5());
+    reset();
+    const trigger = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('.flg-data-grid-chooser-button')!;
+    fireEvent.pointerDown(trigger, { pointerId: 1, buttons: 1 });
+    fireEvent.pointerUp(trigger, { pointerId: 1, buttons: 0 });
+    fireEvent.click(trigger, { detail: 1 });
+    expect(trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true');
+    expect(document.querySelectorAll('.flg-data-grid-chooser input')).toHaveLength(3);
+    const content = document.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-chooser')!;
+    fireEvent(content, Object.assign(new Event('toggle'), { newState: 'closed' }));
+    expect(trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false');
+    expect(renders).toEqual({ headerCell: 0, toolbar: 0, body: 0, cell: 0 });
+  });
+
+  it('draws no row and no title for a `toolbar` function written inline, which the grid calls again', () => {
+    const items = vi.fn();
+    const { rerender } = render(
+      grid5({
+        toolbar: (given) => {
+          items(given);
+          return given.columnChooser;
+        },
+      }),
+    );
+    reset();
+    items.mockClear();
+    rerender(
+      grid5({
+        toolbar: (given) => {
+          items(given);
+          return given.columnChooser;
+        },
+      }),
+    );
+    expect(items).toHaveBeenCalled();
+    // The body draws with the grid; the rows and the titles, which are memoized, do not.
+    expect(renders).toMatchObject({ headerCell: 0, cell: 0 });
+  });
+});

+// ---- The column chooser (spec phase 6 §3.6, §3.8, §4.3 C1 crop e) --------------------------------------
+
+/** The columns of the stories of the menu, with Order that cannot be hidden. */
+const CHOOSER_COLUMNS = REORDER_COLUMNS.map((column) =>
+  'field' in column && column.field === 'id' ? { ...column, allowHiding: false } : column,
+);
+const ChooserGrid = (props: Partial<DataGridProps<Sale>>) => (
+  <ReorderGrid
+    label="Chooser"
+    caption="Orders"
+    columns={CHOOSER_COLUMNS}
+    columnChooser
+    {...props}
+  />
+);
+
+const chooserButton = (root: HTMLElement) =>
+  root.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('.flg-data-grid-chooser-button')!;
+const chooserOf = (root: HTMLElement) => root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-chooser')!;
+const boxOf = (root: HTMLElement, caption: string) =>
+  Array.from(chooserOf(root).querySelectorAll<HTMLInputElement>('input')).find(
+    (input) => input.closest('label')?.textContent === caption,
+  )!;
+const regionOf = (root: HTMLElement) => root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[aria-live="polite"]')!;
+
+/**
+ * The column chooser with the keyboard, in each engine. Tab reaches the button (a stop of its own,
+ * before the table) and Enter opens the popover with the focus on its first box that can change (the
+ * box of Order is disabled: it is always shown, and is not a stop of Tab). Two Tabs reach the box of
+ * Channel, and Space hides the column at once: one change of the layout, the words said, the column
+ * gone from the title and the rows, the popover still open and the focus still on the box. Space again
+ * shows it where it was. The lock row's box is checked and disabled, and described by "Always shown".
+ * Nothing is scrolled. Escape closes the popover and gives the focus back to the button.
+ */
+export const ColumnChooserToggles: Story = {
+  tags: ['no-visual'],
+  args: { onColumnLayoutChange: fn() },
+  render: (args) => <ChooserGrid onColumnLayoutChange={args.onColumnLayoutChange} />,
+  play: async ({ canvasElement, args }) => {
+    const real = await realUserEvent();
+    if (!real) return;
+    const root = rootOf(canvasElement, 'Chooser');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(frameOf(root).clientHeight).toBeGreaterThan(100));
+    const changed = args.onColumnLayoutChange as ReturnType<typeof fn>;
+    const popover = chooserOf(root);
+    const before = scrolls(root);
+    const all = ['Order', 'Customer', 'Status', 'Channel', 'Qty', 'Total'];
+    await expect(captionsOf(root)).toEqual(all);
+    await expect(popover.matches(':popover-open')).toBe(false);
+    // Tab: the button is the first stop, then Enter.
+    await real.tab();
+    await expect(chooserButton(root)).toHaveFocus();
+    await expect(chooserButton(root)).toHaveAccessibleName('Columns');
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(popover.matches(':popover-open')).toBe(true));
+    await expect(chooserButton(root)).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(boxOf(root, 'Customer')).toHaveFocus());
+    // The lock row: the box is checked and cannot change, and says why.
+    const order = boxOf(root, 'Order');
+    await expect(order).toBeChecked();
+    await expect(order).toBeDisabled();
+    await expect(order).toHaveAccessibleDescription('Always shown');
+    const row = order.closest<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-chooser-row')!;
+    const lock = row.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-chooser-lock')!;
+    near(lock.getBoundingClientRect().width, 13, 0.5, 'the lock is 13px wide');
+    near(
+      lock.getBoundingClientRect().right,
+      row.getBoundingClientRect().right,
+      1,
+      'the lock is at the end of its row',
+    );
+    // Channel: hidden by Space, and the popover and the focus stay.
+    await real.tab();
+    await expect(boxOf(root, 'Status')).toHaveFocus();
+    await real.tab();
+    await expect(boxOf(root, 'Channel')).toHaveFocus();
+    await real.keyboard(' ');
+    await waitFor(() =>
+      expect(captionsOf(root)).toEqual(['Order', 'Customer', 'Status', 'Qty', 'Total']),
+    );
+    await expect(changed).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    await expect(changed.mock.calls[0]![0].hidden).toEqual(['channel']);
+    await expect(boxOf(root, 'Channel')).not.toBeChecked();
+    await expect(boxOf(root, 'Channel')).toHaveFocus();
+    await expect(popover.matches(':popover-open')).toBe(true);
+    await waitFor(() => expect(regionOf(root)).toHaveTextContent('Channel hidden'));
+    await expect(columnCells(root, 'Channel')).toHaveLength(0);
+    // Space again: shown where it was.
+    await real.keyboard(' ');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(captionsOf(root)).toEqual(all));
+    await expect(changed).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+    await expect(changed.mock.calls[1]![0].hidden).toEqual([]);
+    await waitFor(() => expect(regionOf(root)).toHaveTextContent('Channel shown'));
+    await expect(boxOf(root, 'Channel')).toHaveFocus();
+    // Escape: closed, and the focus is on the button.
+    await real.keyboard('{Escape}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(popover.matches(':popover-open')).toBe(false));
+    await expect(chooserButton(root)).toHaveFocus();
+    await expect(changed).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+    await expect(scrolls(root)).toEqual(before);
+    await noTitleIsCut(root);
+  },
+};
+
+/**
+ * The column that has the active cell is hidden from the chooser, in each engine: a body cell of
+ * Channel is pressed, Shift+Tab reaches the button, and the popover hides Channel with Space. The
+ * focus stays on the box (the grid does not take it back), and the active cell, the grid's one stop of
+ * Tab, is the cell of the same row in the column that is now at Channel's place, Qty. Escape gives the
+ * focus back to the button, and Tab goes into the grid, to that cell.
+ */
+export const ColumnChooserHidesActiveColumn: Story = {
+  tags: ['no-visual'],
+  render: () => <ChooserGrid />,
+  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
+    const real = await realUserEvent();
+    if (!real) return;
+    const root = rootOf(canvasElement, 'Chooser');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(frameOf(root).clientHeight).toBeGreaterThan(100));
+    await real.click(columnCells(root, 'Channel')[1]!);
+    await expect(columnCells(root, 'Channel')[1]).toHaveFocus();
+    await real.keyboard('{Shift>}{Tab}{/Shift}');
+    await expect(chooserButton(root)).toHaveFocus();
+    await real.keyboard('{Enter}');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(boxOf(root, 'Customer')).toHaveFocus());
+    await real.tab();
+    await real.tab();
+    await expect(boxOf(root, 'Channel')).toHaveFocus();
+    await real.keyboard(' ');
+    await waitFor(() => expect(captionsOf(root)).not.toContain('Channel'));
+    await expect(boxOf(root, 'Channel')).toHaveFocus();
+    const active = columnCells(root, 'Qty')[1]!;
+    await expect(active).toHaveAttribute('tabindex', '0');
+    await real.keyboard('{Escape}');
+    await expect(chooserButton(root)).toHaveFocus();
+    await real.tab();
+    await expect(active).toHaveFocus();
+  },
+};
+
+/** The columns of C1 crop e: the five of the other crops, then Channel (hidden), Qty and Total. */
+const CHOOSER_CROP_COLUMNS = [
+  ...CROP_COLUMNS.map((column) =>
+    'field' in column && column.field === 'id' ? { ...column, allowHiding: false } : column,
+  ),
+  cropColumn('channel', 120),
+  cropColumn('qty', 88),
+  cropColumn('total', 172),
+];
+
+/**
+ * C1, crop e: the chooser opened from the button at the end of the toolbar, with Channel hidden and
+ * Order that cannot be hidden (the lock). The crop is 634px wide with 10px of padding, and its popover
+ * hangs below it, as the mockup's does; the rows are DH-1024 and DH-1025, and the table is cut by the
+ * frame after Status as the crop is. Not drawn here, as in the other looks of C: the search field (D) and
+ * the export button (G), so the button is at the end of the toolbar and the popover, which follows it, is
+ * lined up with its end, and its arrow points at the button; the table stands 4px lower (the grid keeps
+ * 14px between the toolbar and the frame, the crop 10px). The play opens the popover with a press and
+ * lets go of the focus the popover took, as the crop shows no ring.
+ */
+export const ColumnChooser: Story = {
+  tags: ['viewport-1440x720'],
+  render: () => (
+    <div style={{ width: 634 }}>
+      <CropGrid
+        label="Chooser"
+        columns={CHOOSER_CROP_COLUMNS}
+        rows={CROP_ROWS.slice(0, 2)}
+        columnChooser
+        defaultColumnLayout={{ hidden: ['channel'] }}
+      />
+    </div>
+  ),
+  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
+    const root = canvasElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid')!;
+    const widths = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('th.flg-data-grid-head'), (cell) =>
+      Math.round(cell.offsetWidth),
+    );
+    await expect(widths.slice(0, 5)).toEqual([100, 160, 190, 130, 140]);
+    await noTitleIsCut(root);
+    const button = chooserButton(root);
+    near(button.getBoundingClientRect().width, 34, 0.5, 'the button is 34px wide');
+    near(button.getBoundingClientRect().height, 34, 0.5, 'the button is 34px tall');
+    await userEvent.click(button);
+    const popover = chooserOf(root);
+    await waitFor(() => expect(popover.matches(':popover-open')).toBe(true));
+    await settled(popover);
+    // The crop has no box with the focus: the popover took it to its first box, and it is let go.
+    (document.activeElement as HTMLElement).blur();
+    const placed = popover.getBoundingClientRect();
+    const at = button.getBoundingClientRect();
+    // The popover: 220px wide, lined up with the end of the button, 18px under it (8 and the arrow's 10).
+    near(placed.width, 220, 0.5, 'the popover is 220px wide');
+    near(placed.right, at.right, 1, 'the popover ends where the button ends');
+    near(placed.top - at.bottom, 18, 1, 'the popover is 18px under the button');
+    // The boxes in the order of the layout, Channel unchecked, Order checked and disabled.
+    const labels = Array.from(popover.querySelectorAll('label'), (label) => label.textContent);
+    await expect(labels).toEqual([
+      'Order',
+      'Customer',
+      'Assignee',
+      'Order date',
+      'Status',
+      'Channel',
+      'Qty',
+      'Total',
+    ]);
+    await expect(boxOf(root, 'Channel')).not.toBeChecked();
+    await expect(boxOf(root, 'Order')).toBeChecked();
+    await expect(boxOf(root, 'Order')).toBeDisabled();
+    // The boxes are 16px, the lines are 9px apart, and the lock is 13px at the end of its row.
+    const lines = Array.from(popover.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.flg-checkbox'));
+    for (const [at, line] of lines.entries()) {
+      const next = lines[at + 1];
+      if (!next) continue;
+      near(
+        next.getBoundingClientRect().top - line.getBoundingClientRect().bottom,
+        9,
+        0.5,
+        'the lines of the list are 9px apart',
+      );
+    }
+    for (const box of popover.querySelectorAll('.flg-checkbox-box'))
+      near(box.getBoundingClientRect().width, 16, 0.5, 'a box is 16px');
+    const lock = popover.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-chooser-lock')!;
+    near(lock.getBoundingClientRect().width, 13, 0.5, 'the lock is 13px');
+    near(lock.getBoundingClientRect().height, 13, 0.5, 'the lock is 13px tall');
+    await expect(popover.querySelector('.flg-popover-arrow')).not.toBeNull();
+  },
+};
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/column-chooser.test.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/column-chooser.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2a2a362
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/column-chooser.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,90 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import type { DataGridColumnLayout } from '../types';
+import { chooserItems } from './column-chooser';
+
+const column = (id: string, allowHiding = true) => ({ id, caption: id.toUpperCase(), allowHiding });
+const COLUMNS = [column('a', false), column('b'), column('c'), column('d')];
+const layout = (part: Partial<DataGridColumnLayout> = {}): DataGridColumnLayout => ({
+  order: ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd'],
+  widths: {},
+  hidden: [],
+  pinned: {},
+  ...part,
+});
+const ids = (items: ReturnType<typeof chooserItems>) => items.map((item) => item.id);
+
+describe('chooserItems', () => {
+  it('lists every column in the order of the layout, with its caption', () => {
+    const items = chooserItems(COLUMNS, layout({ order: ['c', 'a', 'd', 'b'] }));
+    expect(ids(items)).toEqual(['c', 'a', 'd', 'b']);
+    expect(items.map((item) => item.caption)).toEqual(['C', 'A', 'D', 'B']);
+  });
+
+  it('lists them by zone, the left zone, the middle, then the right zone, as the grid shows them', () => {
+    const items = chooserItems(
+      COLUMNS,
+      layout({ order: ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd'], pinned: { c: 'left', a: 'right' } }),
+    );
+    expect(ids(items)).toEqual(['c', 'b', 'd', 'a']);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps a hidden column at its place, not shown', () => {
+    const items = chooserItems(COLUMNS, layout({ hidden: ['b'] }));
+    expect(ids(items)).toEqual(['a', 'b', 'c', 'd']);
+    expect(items.map((item) => item.shown)).toEqual([true, false, true, true]);
+  });
+
+  it('locks the column that cannot be hidden, and disables its box while it is shown', () => {
+    const items = chooserItems(COLUMNS, layout());
+    expect(items.map((item) => item.locked)).toEqual([true, false, false, false]);
+    expect(items.map((item) => item.disabled)).toEqual([true, false, false, false]);
+  });
+
+  it('lets a locked column that is hidden be shown again', () => {
+    const [first] = chooserItems(COLUMNS, layout({ hidden: ['a'] }));
+    expect(first).toMatchObject({ id: 'a', locked: true, shown: false, disabled: false });
+  });
+
+  it('disables the box of the last column shown, which is not locked', () => {
+    const items = chooserItems(
+      [column('a'), column('b'), column('c')],
+      layout({ order: ['a', 'b', 'c'], hidden: ['a', 'c'] }),
+    );
+    expect(items.map((item) => [item.shown, item.disabled, item.locked])).toEqual([
+      [false, false, false],
+      [true, true, false],
+      [false, false, false],
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('marks the last column shown, and only while it is the only one and not locked', () => {
+    const last = (hidden: string[]) =>
+      chooserItems(COLUMNS, layout({ hidden }))
+        .filter((item) => item.last)
+        .map((item) => item.id);
+    expect(last([])).toEqual([]);
+    expect(last(['a', 'b', 'c'])).toEqual(['d']);
+    expect(last(['b', 'c', 'd'])).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('disables nothing for a column that is not shown, whatever is left', () => {
+    const items = chooserItems(
+      [column('a'), column('b')],
+      layout({ order: ['a', 'b'], hidden: ['b'] }),
+    );
+    expect(items.map((item) => item.disabled)).toEqual([true, false]);
+  });
+
+  it('is empty for no column', () => {
+    expect(chooserItems([], layout({ order: [] }))).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('skips an id of the layout that is no column, and lists a column the layout does not know', () => {
+    expect(ids(chooserItems(COLUMNS, layout({ order: ['x', 'b', 'a'] })))).toEqual([
+      'b',
+      'a',
+      'c',
+      'd',
+    ]);
+  });
+});

Expected: FAIL.
- `engine/column-chooser.test.ts` không nạp được (`Failed to resolve import "./column-chooser" from "src/components/data-grid/engine/column-chooser.test.ts". Does the file exist?`).
- `src/internal/icons.test.tsx`: ca `ColumnsIcon`, `LockIcon` fail (icon chưa được export).
- `DataGrid.chooser.test.tsx` (cả hai project React): fail trên assertion (chưa có nút: `Unable to fire a "pointerdown" event - please provide a DOM element`; thanh công cụ chưa có mục: `expected [ Array(1) ] to deeply equal [ …(3) ]`); các ca vắng mặt (không nút khi không `columnChooser`, thanh chỉ có caption, `toolbar={false}` khi không có tính năng) pass.
- `DataGrid.test-d.ts`: lỗi kiểu (`DataGridToolbarItems` chưa được export; `columnChooser`, `toolbar` chưa có).

Story không chạy ở bước này.

Theo báo cáo của bản nháp (phát hiện 21): `icons.test.tsx` +2 fail trên stub `<svg>` rỗng; `column-chooser.test.ts` với stub trả `[]`: 8 / 9 fail (`expected [] to deeply equal [ 'c', 'a', 'd', 'b' ]`), ca "không cột" là đặc tả; `DataGrid.chooser.test.tsx` trên grid chưa có tính năng: 29 / 35 fail, 6 pass. Sau code 8 fail, cả 8 là lỗi của chính test (con của thanh công cụ gồm cả popover ở top layer; `[popover]` khớp cả menu cột; `fireEvent.click` trên ô bị tắt trong jsdom vẫn đổi nó, nên hai ca "không bị ẩn bởi một lần nhấn" dùng `userEvent`; tên trợ năng của dialog trong jsdom rỗng, nên test kiểm `aria-labelledby` trỏ tới tiêu đề). **Hai test render và test kiểu viết sau** (đặc tả). Story chứng minh bằng đột biến: `disabled={false}` trên các ô làm cả ba story fail ở ba engine. Phần bổ sung: `column-chooser.test.ts` `marks the last column shown…` và hai test của grid (mô tả hiện ra, đi khi cột thứ hai hiện, chuyển sang cột cuối mới) fail trước (3 / 48), ca vừa khoá vừa cuối là đặc tả.

diff --git a/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-13-h2d-glass-ui-phase-6-design.md b/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-13-h2d-glass-ui-phase-6-design.md

+++ b/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-13-h2d-glass-ui-phase-6-design.md
@@ -1051,7 +1051,7 @@ interface DataGridHandle {
   - Chữ dài thì "…" (`overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis`); trình đọc màn hình vẫn đọc đủ. Không có tooltip cho chữ bị cắt (Claude chốt).
   - Ô rỗng không vẽ gì (dòng mới: §4.3 E2).
 - **Caption:** `caption` vẽ trong thanh công cụ (§4.3 G1) bằng phần tử `captionAs`, có id, và đặt tên cho grid; `description` là mô tả của grid (Claude chốt; bản quyết định không có, nhưng G1 đặt tên thẻ cùng hàng thanh công cụ, và grid cần tên).
-- **Thanh công cụ:** hiện khi có caption hay một mục. `toolbar={false}` bỏ nó; `toolbar={(items) => …}` sắp lại các mục mặc định và thêm nút riêng (bản quyết định); mặc định là `groupPanel, spacer, search, columnChooser, exportButton, addButton` sau caption.
+- **Thanh công cụ:** hiện khi có caption, mô tả hay một mục. `toolbar={false}` bỏ các mục và giữ caption (phát hiện khi lập Plan C: caption đặt tên cho grid và cho thanh phân trang, nên không bỏ theo); `toolbar={(items) => …}` đặt thứ nó trả về sau caption thay cho các mục mặc định, nên sắp lại được và thêm nút riêng (bản quyết định); mặc định là `groupPanel, spacer, search, columnChooser, exportButton, addButton` sau caption. Phát hiện khi lập Plan C: `items.spacer` luôn có, mục của tính năng tắt là `null`, và toolbar không có caption, mô tả lẫn mục (spacer không tính là mục) thì không vẽ; một giá trị ngoài union (`true`) là không có `toolbar`. Giai đoạn C chỉ có `spacer` và `columnChooser`; kiểu `DataGridToolbarItems` lớn dần cùng các mục của D, E, F, G.
 - **Sắp xếp:** bấm tiêu đề (hay `Enter`): cột này thành cột sắp duy nhất, chiều kế tiếp của nó (chưa sắp → tăng → giảm → bỏ). Shift+bấm, mod+bấm (hay `Shift+Enter`): giữ các cột khác, thêm cột này (tăng) hay đổi chiều, hay bỏ nó. `sortMode="single"`: phím bổ trợ không có tác dụng. Số thứ tự hiện khi sắp nhiều cột. Thông báo sau khi người dùng bấm (không khi mount, không khi `sort` controlled đổi từ ngoài): `labels.announceSort(sorted)` với `sorted: readonly { caption: string; direction: DataGridSortDirection }[]` dựng cả câu, vd "Sorted by Order date, descending, then Total, ascending" (phát hiện khi lập Plan B); `labels.announceSortCleared`. Chế độ server: chỉ gọi `onSortChange`.
 - **Chọn dòng** (bản quyết định): `single`: bấm dòng chọn dòng (`selectOnRowClick`), `Space` trên ô; không có cột Checkbox. `multiple`: cột Checkbox (tên `labels.selectRow(name)`, `name` là chữ của cột `rowHeader`, hay khoá) và Checkbox "chọn tất cả" ở tiêu đề (`labels.selectAll` hay `labels.selectAllOnPage`; `indeterminate` khi chọn một phần của phạm vi đó); chỉ Checkbox mới chọn trừ khi `selectOnRowClick`. Shift+bấm (dòng hay Checkbox) và `Shift+Space`: chọn khoảng từ dòng neo, theo thứ tự đang hiển thị. `mod+A`: chọn tất cả. Không phân trang (cuộn ảo, `paging={false}`) thì `'page'` là mọi dòng sau lọc. Chọn theo khoá, nên giữ qua lọc, sắp xếp, đổi trang; dòng đã chọn mà bị lọc mất vẫn được chọn. Bấm vào control trong ô (`cell` tuỳ biến) không chọn dòng. Thông báo khi chọn tất cả (ô ở tiêu đề khi bật, `mod+A`) và chọn khoảng: `labels.announceSelected(n)`, `n` là số khoá đã chọn sau đó, mặc định "1 row selected" khi một, "n rows selected" khi khác; bỏ chọn trang bằng ô ở tiêu đề thì không nói gì. +## Choosing columns
+
+`columnChooser` puts a button at the end of the toolbar (an icon button of the library, named by
+`labels.columnChooser`, with a tooltip that does not repeat its name as a description). It opens a
+Popover of the library, 220px wide, under the button and lined up with its end: a title, and one
+box for each data column, with the caption of the column as its label.
+
+- **The order.** The order the grid shows: the left zone, the middle, then the right zone, and a
+  hidden column at its place in the layout's `order`. The column of boxes of `selectionMode` has
+  none.
+- **A box is a change at once.** There is no OK button. Clearing a box hides its column and checking
+  it shows the column again: one change of the layout, one `onColumnLayoutChange` (and
+  `onStateChange` with `'columnLayout'`), and one thing said, `announceHidden` or `announceShown`,
+  because the grid changes behind the popover, out of sight. The popover stays open for the next
+  box, and the focus stays on the box that was pressed. A grid whose parent holds the layout and does
+  not change it leaves the box as it was.
+- **A column that is always shown.** A column with `allowHiding: false` has its box checked and
+  disabled, in a row with a lock at the other end, and the box is described by `labels.lockedColumn`
+  (hidden from the eye). A layout can still hide such a column (`visible: false`, or a saved layout):
+  its box is then unchecked and can be checked, and once it is shown it is locked again.
+- **The last column shown.** Its box is disabled while it is the only one shown, so that the grid is
+  never left with no column. It has no lock: the lock is for a column that says it is always shown. Its
+  box is described by `labels.lastShownColumn` (hidden from the eye) for as long as it is the only one,
+  and a column that is both locked and the last keeps the description of the lock alone.
+- **The keys.** The button is a stop of Tab of its own, before the table. <Kbd keys="enter" /> or
+  <Kbd keys="space" /> on it opens the popover, with the focus on its first box that can change;
+  <Kbd keys="space" /> changes the box that has the focus, <Kbd keys="tab" /> moves among the boxes,
+  and <Kbd keys="esc" /> closes the popover and gives the focus back to the button.
+
+Without `columnChooser` no button is drawn and no popover is mounted.
+
+## Toolbar
+
+The toolbar is the row above the grid: the caption block (see below), then the items of the grid's
+buttons. The only items in this version are `spacer`, which takes the room between the caption and
+the buttons, and `columnChooser`, the button of the chooser; the toolbar gets an item for each part
+of the grid that comes with a button, so `DataGridToolbarItems` grows with the grid. The toolbar is
+drawn when it has a caption, a description or an item.
+
+- **`toolbar={false}`** takes the items away and **keeps the caption**, which names the grid (its
+  `aria-labelledby`) and the pager. Without a caption or a description, the toolbar is not drawn.
+- **`toolbar={(items) => …}`** is called with the items, and what it returns is drawn after the
+  caption in place of the default ones: put the items in the order you want, and add buttons of
+  your own. An item of a feature that is off is `null`; `spacer` is always there. A function that
+  leaves `columnChooser` out leaves the button out, and no popover is mounted.
+
+```tsx
+<DataGrid
+  columns={columns}
+  data={orders}
+  rowKey="id"
+  caption="Orders"
+  columnChooser
+  toolbar={(items) => (
+    <>
+      <Button variant="ghost">Refresh</Button>
+      {items.spacer}
+      {items.columnChooser}
+    </>
+  )}
+/>
+```
+
 ## Caption and name
 
 `caption` is the title of the grid, drawn above it by the element `captionAs` (`'h3'` by default,
 the level of a `CardTitle`; `'h2'` to `'h6'`, or `'div'` for no heading), and it is the name of the
 grid. `description` goes under it and is the description of the grid. They are drawn with the
-classes of a Card header, and without either there is no space above the grid.
+classes of a Card header, in the toolbar, and without either of them, and without a toolbar item,
+there is no space above the grid.
 
 The grid has the `grid` role, and its name is, in order, an `aria-labelledby` you pass, the caption,
 or an `aria-label` you pass. A grid with none of them warns once after it is mounted.
