 ## Props
 
-| Prop                   | Type                                        | Default      | Does                                               |
-| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------------------- |
-| `data`                 | `readonly TRow[]`                           |              | The rows                                           |
-| `rowKey`               | `keyof TRow` or `(row) => string \| number` |              | What a row is known by                             |
-| `columns`              | `readonly DataGridColumn<TRow>[]`           |              | The columns; a stable array                        |
-| `caption`              | `ReactNode`                                 |              | The title and the name                             |
-| `description`          | `ReactNode`                                 |              | What the grid is about                             |
-| `captionAs`            | `'h2'` to `'h6'` or `'div'`                 | `'h3'`       | The element of the caption                         |
-| `variant`              | `'lined' \| 'striped' \| 'minimal'`         | `'lined'`    | The look of a Table                                |
-| `density`              | `'compact' \| 'standard' \| 'comfortable'`  | `'standard'` | The height of a row                                |
-| `rowHeight`            | `number`                                    |              | The height of a row in pixels, over the table's    |
-| `locale`               | `string`                                    | `'en-US'`    | The language of numbers and dates (see below)      |
-| `timeZone`             | `string`                                    | `'UTC'`      | The zone a `datetime` is shown in                  |
-| `height`               | `number \| string`                          |              | The height of the grid; with it the heading sticks |
-| `scrolling`            | `'standard' \| 'virtual'`                   | `'standard'` | `'virtual'` draws only the rows near the view      |
-| `loading`              | `boolean`                                   | `false`      | Skeleton rows with no row, a layer over the rows   |
-| `rowClassName`         | `(row) => string \| undefined`              |              | A class for a row; a stable function               |
-| `allowSorting`         | `boolean`                                   | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowSorting`       |
-| `allowResizing`        | `boolean`                                   | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowResizing`      |
-| `allowReordering`      | `boolean`                                   | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowReordering`    |
-| `allowPinning`         | `boolean`                                   | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowPinning`       |
-| `allowHiding`          | `boolean`                                   | `true`       | The default of every column's `allowHiding`        |
-| `sortMode`             | `'single' \| 'multiple'`                    | `'multiple'` | Whether a press with a modifier adds a level       |
-| `sort`                 | `readonly DataGridSortItem[]`               |              | The sort, in order (controlled)                    |
-| `defaultSort`          | `readonly DataGridSortItem[]`               |              | The sort at first                                  |
-| `onSortChange`         | `(sort) => void`                            |              | Called with the sort a press asks for              |
-| `paging`               | `false \| { pageSize?, pageSizes? }`        | see above    | A page's size at first, and the sizes offered      |
-| `page`                 | `DataGridPage`                              |              | The page, from 0 (controlled)                      |
-| `defaultPage`          | `DataGridPage`                              |              | The page at first                                  |
-| `onPageChange`         | `(page) => void`                            |              | Called with the page that is asked for             |
-| `onStateChange`        | `(state, changed) => void`                  |              | The whole state, after sort, page, keys or layout  |
-| `onRowActivate`        | `(row, key) => void`                        |              | Called by Enter or a double press on a row         |

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/column-chooser.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/column-chooser.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..9acc3ed
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/column-chooser.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+import type { DataGridColumnLayout } from '../types';
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from './columns';
+
+/** One box of the column chooser. */
+export interface ChooserItem {
+  readonly id: string;
+  readonly caption: string;
+  readonly shown: boolean;
+  /** The column says `allowHiding: false`: the chooser draws a lock beside its box. */
+  readonly locked: boolean;
+  /** The column is the only one shown and is not locked: its box is disabled for that. */
+  readonly last: boolean;
+  /** The box cannot change: the column is shown and is locked, or is the only one shown. */
+  readonly disabled: boolean;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The boxes of the column chooser (spec phase 6 §6.3): every data column, in the order the grid shows
+ * them (the left zone, the middle, then the right zone; a hidden column at its place in `order`), from
+ * the layout as it is shown. A box that is not checked can always be checked; a box that is checked
+ * cannot be cleared for a locked column, nor for the only column shown, so that a grid never has none.
+ * A locked column that a layout hides can be shown again: the lock is about the user hiding it.
+ */
+export function chooserItems(
+  columns: readonly Pick<ResolvedColumn<unknown>, 'id' | 'caption' | 'allowHiding'>[],
+  layout: DataGridColumnLayout,
+): ChooserItem[] {
+  const byId = new Map(columns.map((column) => [column.id, column]));
+  const known = layout.order.filter((id, at) => byId.has(id) && layout.order.indexOf(id) === at);
+  const order = [
+    ...known,
+    ...columns.map((column) => column.id).filter((id) => !known.includes(id)),
+  ];
+  // Whatever is no pin is the middle, so that a column is never lost to a layout that is not clean.
+  const side = (id: string) => layout.pinned[id];
+  const listed = [
+    ...order.filter((id) => side(id) === 'left'),
+    ...order.filter((id) => side(id) !== 'left' && side(id) !== 'right'),
+    ...order.filter((id) => side(id) === 'right'),
+  ];
+  const shownCount = listed.filter((id) => !layout.hidden.includes(id)).length;
+  return listed.map((id) => {
+    const column = byId.get(id)!;
+    const shown = !layout.hidden.includes(id);
+    return {
+      id,
+      caption: column.caption,
+      shown,
+      locked: !column.allowHiding,
+      last: shown && column.allowHiding && shownCount === 1,
+      disabled: shown && (!column.allowHiding || shownCount === 1),
+    };
+  });
+}

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d92f6d3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/ColumnChooser.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,106 @@
+import { memo, useId, useMemo } from 'react';
+import { ColumnsIcon, LockIcon } from '../../../internal/icons';
+import { Checkbox } from '../../checkbox/Checkbox';
+import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger } from '../../popover/Popover';
+import { TooltipContent, TooltipRoot, TooltipTrigger } from '../../tooltip/Tooltip';
+import { chooserItems } from '../engine/column-chooser';
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from '../engine/columns';
+import type { DataGridColumnLayout, DataGridLabels } from '../types';
+
+export interface ColumnChooserProps {
+  /** The caller's columns, shown or not. */
+  columns: readonly Pick<ResolvedColumn<unknown>, 'id' | 'caption' | 'allowHiding'>[];
+  /** The layout as shown. */
+  layout: DataGridColumnLayout;
+  labels: DataGridLabels;
+  /** A box was changed: the column is to be shown, or hidden. */
+  onToggle: (columnId: string, show: boolean) => void;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The column chooser (spec phase 6 §3.6, §4.3 C1 crop e, §6.3 "Chọn cột"): the icon button of the
+ * toolbar and the Popover of the library it opens, with a box for each column. A box shows or hides
+ * its column at once, and the popover stays open for the next. The Popover is the grid's one, and is
+ * mounted only for a grid that asks for the chooser. Its list is drawn only while it is open, as a
+ * Popover draws its content, and the grid draws no title and no row for what is done in it.
+ */
+export const ColumnChooser = memo(function ColumnChooser({
+  columns,
+  layout,
+  labels,
+  onToggle,
+}: ColumnChooserProps) {
+  const titleId = useId();
+  const lockedId = useId();
+  const lastId = useId();
+  const items = useMemo(() => chooserItems(columns, layout), [columns, layout]);
+  const anyLocked = items.some((item) => item.locked);
+  const anyLast = items.some((item) => item.last);
+  return (
+    <Popover>
+      {/* The tooltip says the name the button has already, so it does not describe it. */}
+      <TooltipRoot describe={false}>
+        <TooltipTrigger>
+          <PopoverTrigger
+            variant="secondary"
+            size="md"
+            className="flg-data-grid-chooser-button"
+            data-icon-only=""
+            aria-label={labels.columnChooser}
+          >
+            <ColumnsIcon />
+          </PopoverTrigger>
+        </TooltipTrigger>
+        <TooltipContent side="bottom" align="center" sideOffset={8}>
+          {labels.columnChooser}
+        </TooltipContent>
+      </TooltipRoot>
+      <PopoverContent
+        side="bottom"
+        align="end"
+        className="flg-data-grid-chooser"
+        aria-labelledby={titleId}
+      >
+        <div id={titleId} className="flg-data-grid-chooser-title">
+          {labels.columnChooser}
+        </div>
+        <div className="flg-data-grid-chooser-list">
+          {items.map((item) => {
+            const box = (
+              <Checkbox
+                key={item.id}
+                checked={item.shown}
+                disabled={item.disabled}
+                aria-describedby={item.locked ? lockedId : item.last ? lastId : undefined}
+                onCheckedChange={(checked) => onToggle(item.id, checked)}
+              >
+                {item.caption}
+              </Checkbox>
+            );
+            // A column that is always shown has its lock at the end of its row.
+            return item.locked ? (

+          <span id={lockedId} hidden>
+            {labels.lockedColumn}
+          </span>
+        ) : null}
+      </PopoverContent>
+    </Popover>

+    near(more.getBoundingClientRect().height, 20, 0.5, 'the ⋮ is 20px tall');
+    await expect(chooserButton(root)).toBeInTheDocument();
+  },
+};
+

+/**

+ * and the 3px bar of DH-1028 drawn through the pinned cells. Not drawn here: the funnels (D) and the
